Result: 1）扩展性：朴素合并的专家读 I/O 与墙钟时间随 K 近线性增长；MergePipe 将访问集限制在 B 内，专家读取近乎持平，相对全读有数量级的专家 I/O 降低，最高 11× 加速。2）预算行为（Figure 3、附录 B）：10%–100% 预算扫描中，实际专家读 I/O、访问块比例与墙钟时间随预算单调增长且始终不超过上限；收紧预算主要削减专家读，基座读与输出写近乎固定，说明收益来自 expert-read 项而非元数据效应。3）算子通用性（Llama-3.1-8B，I/O 单位 GB）：K=8 时 AVG 70.7→3.46 GB、136.2s→64.1s（-53.0%），TIES 79.5→3.46 GB、614.3s→51.1s（-91.7%），DARE 79.5→3.46 GB、99.1s→44.7s（-54.9%）；K=20 时 AVG 171.0→3.46 GB（-6.8%）、TIES 174.4→3.46 GB（-70.4%）、DARE 173.2→3.46 GB（-10.7%），稀疏方法受益最大。4）保真度（Qwen3-0.6B，TIES，K=20）：预算归一化到全读 TIES 端点（其 touched ratio 因 TIES 自身稀疏化仅 0.247），预算 0.5 时 touched 0.101、相对 ℓ2 偏差 8.84e-4、P95 块偏差 3.98e-3；各预算下偏差均保持 O(10⁻³)，HumanEval/IFEval/DROP 与全读基线接近且无单调退化（如 0.9 预算 HumanEval 42.68 vs 39.71）。5）系统开销（Qwen3-0.6B，16 专家）：规划 1.21s（占执行 1.04%），执行 116.62s，实际专家读 I/O 23,349MB（1.18× 预算前），元数据 catalog 3,468MB（占总 I/O 3.79%），manifest 812KB（<0.001%）。

Conclusion: MergePipe 将权重空间模型合并重述为"预算化专家访问集"问题，核心贡献是把"读哪些专家权重"提升为一等预算资源，实现逻辑合并规则与物理访问模式的分离。理论上给出预算可靠性、满预算一致性与固定系数加性算子的遗漏更新界（并给出仅选中重归一化时的系数漂移界）；工程上以 catalog–plan–execute 架构实现确定性访问计划、掩码感知执行与可重放 manifest/原子发布。实验表明在 Qwen/Llama 检查点族上可把随 K 线性增长的全量专家扫描转为近似平坦的预算访问，最多一个数量级 I/O 降低与 11× 加速，同时保持 O(10⁻³) 量级参数偏差与稳定的下游行为，形成可调的吞吐–保真前沿。局限：仅约束 expert-read 项；假设专家处于同一权重坐标系，不处理置换/对称/表示对齐；仅满预算恢复标准合并，低预算为显式近似，TIES/DARE 等非线性稀疏算子的保真度只能经验评估；当专家集较小、稠密全读或 GPU 内存内融合时收益有限；更适合离线、迭代式、磁盘驻留专家的大规模合并场景。作者进一步主张，随着模型家族持续增长，权重空间方法应与把权重视为结构化、预算化数据（而非不透明文件）的执行层相配套。

Abstract: Weight-space model merging is usually formulated as an algebraic operation on checkpoints, yet at LLM scale the limiting resource is often the set of expert weights that must be read. We introduce MergePipe, a budget-aware execution layer that casts LLM merging as an \emph{expert access-set} problem: given a merge operator and a checkpoint family in a shared weight coordinate system, choose which expert delta blocks to access under an explicit I/O budget. MergePipe indexes parameter blocks, builds deterministic access plans, and executes the induced budgeted merge with replayable manifests. The plan is budget-sound by construction and recovers the full-read merge at full budget; for fixed-coefficient additive operators, the omitted-update error is bounded by the norm of omitted deltas. Across Qwen and Llama merging workloads, MergePipe reduces expert-read I/O by up to an order of magnitude and achieves up to $11\times$ speedups. Representative budget sweeps show $O(10^{-3})$ parameter deviation from full-read merges and no monotonic degradation on downstream benchmarks.

</details>


### [234] [Gradient Perturbation: Learning to Perturb Gradients for Adaptive Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29494)
*Hua Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"梯度扰动"(gradient perturbation)统一框架：首次将 SAM、梯度裁剪、梯度噪声注入、梯度投影等方法统一解释为对参数梯度 g̃ = g + δ_g 的特定扰动形式，并类比 Logit Perturbation Learning (LPL) 提出两条猜想——放大某类梯度范数相当于对该类做"正增强"，抑制则相当于"负增强"。据此提出 LPG (Learning to Perturb Gradients)：在低维 logit 梯度空间（维度 C）而非高维参数空间中，按类别自适应地扰动 logit 梯度，从而实现类别感知的训练。理论上证明了 LPG 与 LPL 的前向-后向对偶性（LPL 是 LPG 的特例但表达力更弱），并给出基于 PAC-Bayesian 的泛化界，将扰动界 ε_c 与泛化差距联系起来。实验覆盖平衡分类、长尾分类与噪声标签学习，LPG 全面优于基线，并可作为即插即用模块与 LPL/LA/SAM 叠加获得增益，训练开销仅约 3%（闭式解）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络训练包含前向传播链（特征→logits→损失）与后向传播链（损失→梯度→参数更新）。现有扰动研究几乎全部集中于前向链：特征扰动（数据增强、对抗训练）、logit 扰动（标签平滑、Logit Adjustment、LPL）、标签扰动（Mixup）；而后向链中的"梯度扰动"虽被隐式使用却缺乏系统研究。SAM、梯度裁剪、梯度噪声注入、PCGrad 等方法各自独立提出、动机不同，共享 g̃ = g + δ_g 的结构却没有统一视角。观察图1可见：SAM 对所有类别近似均匀扰动，梯度裁剪只影响大梯度类（长尾下即头部类），梯度噪声为各向同性——三者均无法按类别特性自适应。因此作者希望建立梯度扰动的统一形式化框架，并将其与前向的正/负增强建立对应关系，从而引出类别感知的梯度扰动设计。

Method: （1）统一框架：将梯度裁剪写为 δ_g^clip = g(min(1, τ/‖g‖)−1)（仅在 ‖g‖>τ 时沿原方向收缩）；梯度噪声为各向同性 N(0,σ²I)；SAM 由泰勒展开得 δ_g^SAM = ρ∇²l·ĝ（曲率依赖）；梯度投影重塑方向。（2）两条猜想：Conjecture 1 ‖g̃_c‖>‖ḡ_c‖ ⇒ 对类 c 的正增强；Conjecture 2 ‖g̃_c‖<‖ḡ_c‖ ⇒ 负增强。（3）LPG：利用 g_i = J_i h_i 的链式分解，在 logit 梯度空间施加类别级扰动 h̃_i = h_i + δ_c^h（δ_c^h ∈ R^C），参数扰动为 δ_c = J_i δ_c^h；目标为正增强类最大化 ‖J_i^T(h_i+δ)‖、负增强类最小化之。（4）高效求解：沿 h_c 方向缩放的闭式解 h̃_c = h_c(1 ± α_c/‖h_c‖)，无需显式计算 Jacobian；另给出 PGD 版本（T=3）在完整 R^C 空间优化并投影到 ℓ2 球。（5）类别划分：平衡分类按运行平均准确率（低于 τ 为正增强）；长尾按类频次（稀有类正增强）；噪声标签按类内 logit 梯度方差 Var(h_c)（高方差类判为含噪更多、予以抑制）。（6）扰动界 ε_c = ε + Δε·|τ − s̄_c|，离阈值越远扰动越强。算法上在反向传播得到 logit 梯度后、继续回传前进行扰动（PyTorch 中用 hook 拦截 logit 层梯度）。

Result: 平衡分类（CIFAR-10/100）：CIFAR-10 上 WRN-28-10 误差 LPG-PGD 3.11%（CE 3.89%、LPL 3.28%、SAM 3.46%）；CIFAR-100 ResNet-110 误差 22.15%（LPL 22.65%，绝对提升 0.37%–0.5%）。跨架构（CIFAR-100）ResNet-32/SE-ResNet-110/WRN-16-8 均优于 ISDA 与 LPL（如 ResNet-32 25.28% vs LPL 25.82%）。长尾分类：CIFAR-100-LT（不平衡比 100）整体准确率 32.0%，超 LPL 3.2%、超 SAM 6.1%，尾部类提升最显著且头部性能保持。噪声标签：CIFAR-10 在 80% 对称噪声下准确率 75.5%，超 DivideMix 2.7%，验证"抑制高梯度方差类"抑制噪声的机制。即插即用性：LA+LPG、LPL+LPG、SAM+LPG 均优于各自基线，LPG 与 LPL 的增益近似可加，印证前向改损失面、后向改优化轨迹的互补性。消融：闭式解已足够强（T=3 提升有限）；ε∈[0.1,0.5] 稳定，>1.0 因过度扰动而变差；t-SNE 显示类内更紧致、类间间隔更大，尾类尤为明显。开销：ResNet-110/CIFAR-100 上闭式仅增约 3% 训练时间（PGD T=3 约 8%），低于 SAM 的 15%。

Conclusion: 梯度扰动可作为与前向扰动并列的独立研究维度，其统一形式 g̃ = g + δ_g 解释了 SAM、梯度裁剪、噪声注入等方法的共性，并暴露出它们在类别自适应性上的缺失。LPG 通过在低维 logit 梯度空间实施类别级自适应扰动，实现了类别感知训练，效果优于 LPL 且与之互补，为长尾与噪声标签场景提供了简洁有效的统一方案。理论层面证明了 LPL 在一阶近似下是 LPG 的特例（受限于 ∂²l/∂u² 的值域，因交叉熵 Hessian 半正定无法产生 LPG 能产生的方向变化），并借 PAC-Bayesian 框架导出 ε_c 与泛化差距的权衡关系：更大的扰动界增大泛化差距但通过更强增强降低扰动后的经验损失，存在最优 ε_c。局限与未来工作：扩展至样本级梯度扰动、与课程学习结合做自适应扰动调度、拓展至语言建模与生成任务等场景。

Abstract: Deep neural network training involves both forward propagation (from features through logits to loss) and backward propagation (from loss through gradients to parameter updates). While perturbations along the forward chain, including feature perturbation, logit perturbation, and label perturbation, have been extensively studied, the backward chain's gradient perturbation has received little systematic investigation. In this paper, we establish a unified framework for gradient perturbation, revealing that existing methods such as Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM), gradient clipping, and gradient noise injection can all be interpreted as imposing specific forms of gradient perturbation. Analogous to the recently proposed Logit Perturbation Learning (LPL), we conjecture that amplifying the gradient norm for a class acts as positive augmentation (enhancing learning), while dampening it acts as negative augmentation (suppressing overfitting). Based on these observations, we propose Learning to Perturb Gradients (LPG), which adaptively perturbs logit-level gradients at the class level to achieve category-aware training. We also establish theoretical connections between gradient perturbation bounds and generalization guarantees via PAC-Bayesian analysis. Experiments on balanced classification, long-tail classification, and noisy label learning demonstrate that LPG consistently outperforms existing methods and can be combined with them as a plug-in module.

</details>


### [235] [On-Policy Replay for Continual Supervised Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29495)
*Yan Chen,Taojie Zhu,Meng Zhang,Xin Chen,Jiaqi Huang,Dongyang Xu,Yizhi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OPR 不改损失函数、也不需要教师模型，而是把「在策略」信号注入跨任务回放缓冲区：每个任务训练结束后，用当前检查点对历史提示做小规模 rollout，按任务奖励（OPR-RU）或模型自身长度归一化对数概率（OPR-SC）筛选出 top-b 对 (prompt, response)，当作普通 SFT 样本混入下一阶段训练。在 TRACE 上以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct / Qwen3-8B / Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 为骨干，ρ=0.01 时将 |BWT| 相对调优后的 Vanilla Replay 降低 42%–46%（如 Qwen2.5 从 -4.27 降至 -2.29），整体准确率高于 Vanilla Replay 约 3–5pp；低分回放消融反而劣于 Vanilla Replay，证明关键成分是「在策略分布 + 高奖励筛选」而非单纯回放或单纯响应质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在部署后被持续用 SFT 逐任务适配，顺序微调会造成严重的灾难性遗忘（Sequential SFT 的 BWT 可达 -10.85 至 -17.07 个百分点）。近期诊断共识是：SFT 本质是 off-policy 的，相邻策略在历史提示上的 per-update KL 支配了遗忘量，因此缓解遗忘等价于在流水线中某处注入 on-policy 信号。已有方法（SDFT、OPSD、GKD、RazorSFT）都把该信号放在损失侧：引入教师副本的逐 token KL 项，或改写当前任务的目标响应，因而带来额外的教师前向计算、EMA/KL 系数的调度敏感性、以及教师自身的风格漂移与幻觉继承。作者的核心观察是：真正的约束不在损失而在训练数据分布，而每个回放式持续学习器都已经持有这样一份跨任务缓冲区——它却是用陈旧的 off-policy 金标填充的。把缓冲区本身变成 on-policy，是强制 KL 收缩最廉价的路径，且完全不动训练循环。

Method: 【算法流程】阶段 i 结束后，用最新检查点 π_θi 通过 vLLM（temperature 0.1、top-p 1、最多 512 新 token）对历史任务的提示各采样一次（丢弃金标），用打分器排序，取 top-b（b=ρ·n_{i+1}，在 i 个先验任务间尽量均分）构成回放缓冲区 B_{i+1}，与 D_{i+1} 拼接后做标准 token 级交叉熵 SFT。每阶段只 rollout 一次，计算量被训练开销摊薄。

【打分器】OPR-RU：按各任务自身评测指标打分（分类用 exact-match、Py150 用 token 级 fuzz、MeetingBank 用 ROUGE-L、20Minuten 用 SARI），因过滤与评测同指标而天然对齐；OPR-SC：标签无关，用模型自身长度归一化对数概率（采样器免费返回），适用于无可靠标注的生产环境。

【KL 收缩解释】以 Shenfeld 等的界 Δ_i ≤ C·E_{x~p_i}[KL(π_θt‖π_θt−1)] + o(‖Δθ‖²) 为起点，定义缓冲区分布 q_{t−1}(y|x) = π_{θt−1}(y|x)·1[r(x,y)≥τ]/Z(x)。对 OPR-SC 有恒等式 r_SC = -ℓ(θ_{t−1};x,ỹ)/|ỹ|，故 top-b 筛选等价于在旧策略处对每样本损失的上界 ℓ_max = -|ỹ|·τ；OPR-RU 则依赖「规则奖励与 log π 正相关」的经验假设。结合 L-光滑性下的 ‖∇ℓ‖² ≤ 2Lℓ、Jensen 不等式、以及 E_q[∇ℓ] = ∇E_x[KL(q‖π_θ)]，可得 replay 部分的梯度既小又指向旧策略，从而 E_{p_hist}[KL(π_θt‖π_θt−1)] ≤ Lσ_max η² ℓ_max + o(η²)。该界由 q 的两个成分共同支撑：仅保留 on-policy 采样但把指示函数换成 1[r≤τ]，Eq.(5) 仍成立而 Eq.(3) 失效，理论因而预言低分回放会劣于 off-policy 金标回放。数据侧路线是单边的——该界只约束每个 batch 的 replay 部分，新任务梯度不受约束。

【实验设置】TRACE 八任务（C-STANCE、FOMC、MeetingBank、Py150、ScienceQA、NumGLUE-cm/ds、20Minuten），每任务 5000 训练样本；AdamW、lr 1e-5、cosine、无 warmup、weight decay 0、全局 batch 128、max len 2048、bf16、3 seeds；8×H100 + DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 + Liger Kernel，单模型全流程 32 GPU-小时。对比基线：Sequential SFT、MTL（上界）、Vanilla Replay、SDFT。

Result: 【主结果，ρ=0.01】顺序 SFT 全面崩塌（BWT -10.85 ~ -17.07）；Vanilla Replay 恢复到 -3.37 ~ -5.36；OPR-RU 进一步降至 -1.97 ~ -2.89，|BWT| 相对 Vanilla Replay 削减 42%–46%；OPR-SC 与 OPR-RU 几乎持平（-1.77 ~ -2.67），说明增益来自结构而非打分器。ACC 上 OPR 优于 Vanilla Replay 约 2.9–3.9pp（如 Qwen2.5：65.45 vs 62.57），并比 SDFT 高 3–5pp。

【与 SDFT 的对比】SDFT 的 BWT 略优（差约 1.5pp 以内），但在整体准确率和长文本任务上崩溃：MeetingBank 相对 Vanilla Replay 低 23–32pp（自蒸馏教师继承自身幻觉且无外部奖励信号）；分阶段训练损失曲线显示 SDFT 在 MeetingBank、Py150、20Minuten 三个需要大幅分布迁移的阶段损失停滞在高一数量级，而四个分类任务两者几乎不可区分——即反向 KL 锚定恰好阻碍了最需要下降损失的任务。

【预算敏感性】ρ∈{0.01,0.02,0.05,0.10}：OPR-RU 的 |BWT| 削减幅度 46%–60%，ACC 几乎持平（波动 0.47pp），而 Vanilla Replay 的 ACC 随预算波动 3.51pp——缓冲区在策略化后，「回放质量」压过「回放数量」。

【反证消融】固定提示集、采样器与代码，仅把高分 rollout 换成同批次低分 rollout：BWT 从 -0.65 恶化到 -3.47（5.3 倍），甚至劣于 off-policy 的 Vanilla Replay（-1.37），与理论预言一致，排除「回放即有收益」的解释。

【打分器对比】OPR-SC 在校准良好的任务（FOMC、ScienceQA）上强，在模型「自信地犯错」的任务（NumGLUE-cm）上受损，因为流畅但错误的 rollout 也能通过置信度过滤——缓冲区只能锚定模型已置信的区域，无法制造新能力。

Conclusion: 遗忘可由历史提示上的 per-update KL 界定，而先前工作一律在损失侧强制该界（教师网络、辅助 KL 项、改写目标）。本文证明仅通过跨任务回放缓冲区即可强制：缓冲样本取自上一检查点并经奖励过滤，从而在 θ_{t−1} 处给出每样本损失上界，并以恒等式下降 KL(q_{t−1}‖π_θ)，SFT 循环完全不变。损失侧与数据侧方法由此被统一为同一代理目标的两种编码；低分回放消融证伪了「随便回放都行」的解释。局限：仅在三个 7–8B 指令模型与 TRACE 英文八任务序列上验证，未覆盖基座模型、10B 以上规模、其他任务顺序与非英语流；OPR-RU 依赖任务特定评测器，而 OPR-SC 虽解除该依赖却在「自信地犯错」的输入上失效。作者指出下一步是端到端学习打分器以取代手工指标或逐 token 似然。

Abstract: Continual supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the de facto recipe for adapting large language models (LLMs) to a stream of downstream tasks, but it suffers from catastrophic forgetting of earlier capabilities. Recent work shows that on-policy signals -- training on the model's own outputs -- reduce forgetting more reliably than off-policy supervision. Existing on-policy methods route this signal through a new training objective (e.g., self-distillation losses with a teacher copy), inheriting an extra forward pass, schedule sensitivity, and stylistic drift from the teacher.We instead route the on-policy signal through the training data source. Our method, On-Policy Replay (OPR), rolls out the most recent checkpoint on a small budget of historical prompts, filters the generations by a task reward, and replays the surviving (prompt, model response) pairs as ordinary SFT examples. There is no teacher, no auxiliary loss, and no on-the-fly distillation. Across three 7--8B instruction-tuned backbones (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B, Llama3.1-8B-Instruct) on the TRACE continual-learning benchmark, OPR consistently reduces forgetting; on the sharpest stress test (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Sequential SFT BWT -13.93), OPR lifts BWT to -0.65 at a 10% replay budget and to -2.29 at a 1% budget -- a 46% reduction in |BWT| over a tuned Vanilla Replay baseline, with 42--46% reductions observed across all three backbones. We give a KL-shrinkage interpretation that places OPR and prior on-policy distillation methods on a single axis, and we present a counterintuitive finding that explains why Vanilla Replay is already a strong baseline: low-score replay is uniformly worse than Vanilla Replay, demonstrating that the active ingredient in OPR is the on-policy distribution, not the response quality alone.Our code is available at https://github.com/Yancey2024/OnPolicyReplay.

</details>


### [236] [Convex Basins in Single-Index Model Loss Landscapes: Applications to Robust Recovery under Strong Adversarial Corruption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29497)
*Santanu Das,Sagnik Chatterjee,Jatin Batra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文给出首个在重尾噪声 + 常数比例强对抗污染下，对通用非单调链接函数（如 GeLU、Swish）单指标模型（SIM）具有近线性样本与时间复杂度的鲁棒恢复算法。核心贡献是全新的损失景观结构刻画：证明在满足温和条件（f′, f″ 的高斯四阶矩有界 + 局部曲率半径条件）的链接函数下，平方损失在真参数 β* 周围存在**与维度无关的常半径凸盆地**；并提出新条件 ESC（Expected Squared Convexity，期望平方凸性），刻画信号方向何时可由二阶矩识别。二者结合，使「鲁棒谱初始化 + 鲁棒梯度下降」两阶段算法以 Õ(d) 样本、Õ(nd) 时间达到 O(σ√ε) 的 ℓ₂ 估计误差，覆盖 Phase Retrieval、GeLU、Swish、Tanh、Probit、Logistic。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单指数模型（SIM, Y = f(Xᵀβ*) + ζ）是一类统一的半参数模型，涵盖线性回归、逻辑回归、相位反演与广义线性模型。在高维、噪声重尾且存在常数比例对抗污染的现实数据下，经典一阶方法（Arous et al.、Ren et al. 等）依赖的鞅漂移分解要求随机偏差零均值，而对抗者在高维中会破坏这一性质，导致已有证明技术失效。已有的鲁棒恢复结果仅覆盖线性回归（Pensia et al., JASA 2024）、严格单调链接（Awasthi et al., NeurIPS 2022）与相位反演（Buna & Rebeschini, AISTATS 2025；Das & Batra, 2026）。而现代门控架构（Transformer、GLU）中的标量原语如 GeLU、Swish 是典型的非对称非单调链接，此前不存在任何鲁棒恢复保证。此外，非单调链接常具高信息指数（IE），在无污染设定下获取凸盆地往往需要张量 PCA 等高代价方法；因此核心问题是：能否刻画一类链接函数，使得在重尾噪声与强对抗污染下仍可获得高效可证的鲁棒恢复？

Method: 模型设定：X ~ N(0, I_d)，||β*||=1，链接函数 f 已知，噪声 ζ 条件零均值、同方差 σ²、有界四阶矩 K₄；ε∈(0,1/2) 比例样本被强对抗污染（可同时篡改协变量与响应）。

两项结构性假设：
- 假设 2.1（凸盆地条件）：定义局部高斯矩包络 M₁(R), M₂(R) 与 C_lip(R)=M₁(R)M₂(R)，要求 μ=λ_min(∇²L(β*))>0，且存在 R>0 使 6√15·R·C_lip(R) ≤ μ。由于 M₁,M₂ 仅由一维高斯积分决定，R 与 d 无关。
- 假设 2.2（ESC，期望平方凸性）：ESC(β,f)=E[(f′(Xᵀβ))² + f(Xᵀβ)f″(Xᵀβ)] > 0。由乘积法则 ESC = E[(f²)″]，是单调性条件 E[f′(Z)]>0 的二阶类比：它刻画二阶矩是否携带 β* 信息。

技术路线：
1) 凸盆地存在性（定理 3.1）：在 β* 处用高斯旋转对称性把 H(β*) 分解为各向同性项 + 秩一项（Lemma B.1），得 λ_min=μ、λ_max=μ₁；对 H(β)−H(β*) 做微扰分析，用微积分基本定理将差写为 (Xᵀh)·C̄ 的形式，以 Hölder/Minkowski 控 ‖C̄‖_{L²} ≤ 3M₁M₂，用高斯混合矩不等式 E[(Xᵀh)²(Xᵀv)⁴] ≤ 15‖h‖²（Lemma B.2）得 ‖ΔH‖_op ≤ 3√15·C_lip(R)‖β−β*‖，再由 Weyl 不等式得整个球 B(β*,R) 上 μ/2·I ⪯ H(β) ⪯ (μ/2+μ₁)·I。
2) 可达性（Lemma 4.1/4.2、定理 4.2）：令 Ỹ=YX，二阶 Stein 引理给出 E[ỸỸᵀ] = (σ²+E[f²])I + 2·ESC(β*,f)·β*β*ᵀ，故 β* 是主特征向量且特征间隙为 2c；证明 Ỹ 满足 (4,C₄) 超契约性（C₄ = O((E[f⁸]^{1/8}+K₄)/σ)），从而可用 Jambulapati et al. (2024) 的线性时间鲁棒超契约 1-ePCA 得到 ‖β₀−β*‖ = O(C₄√(σ²+E[f²]+c)·ε^{1/4}/√c)，并保证 β₀ 落入凸盆地内。
3) 鲁棒梯度下降（定理 4.3）：步长 η=2/(α+γ)=(2/(μ+μ₁))，用 Diakonikolas et al. (2022) 的鲁棒均值估计替代总体梯度；通过协方差迹/算子范数界（Lemma D.2：‖Σ‖_op ≤ 6φ₁‖β−β*‖²+√3σ²φ₂）与归纳论证证明所有迭代始终留在凸盆地内，且 ‖β_P−β*‖ ≤ R·exp(−Pγ/(α+γ)) + (σ√φ₂/γ)O(√ε)，从而突破谱初始化的 ε^{1/4} 误差地板。
4) 组合（算法 1）：样本分割为 P+1 桶，前一桶做 LRSI 初始化，后续桶做 LRGD 精修，最终归一化输出。附录给出 Logistic/Tanh/Probit/Phase Retrieval/GeLU/Swish 的 ESC、μ、μ₁、R、C_lip、φ₁、φ₂ 数值表。

Result: 定理 4.1（主结果）：在假设 2.1、2.2 下，算法 1 以 n=Õ(d) 样本、Õ(nd) 时间（对数因子隐藏），在常数比例 ε 对抗污染与方差 σ² 的重尾噪声下，以高概率输出 ‖β̂−β*‖₂ = O(σ√ε)。其中允许的污染水平 ε = O(min{1/C₄⁴, c²min{R⁴,1}/(C₄⁴(σ²+E[f²]+c)²), γ²/φ₁, γ²R²/(σ²φ₂)})。推论 4.1：对 Phase Retrieval、GeLU、Swish、Tanh、Probit、Logistic 六类链接函数均成立，样本 Õ(d)、时间 Õ(nd)、误差 O(σ√ε)。

关键量级关系：谱初始化单独可达的误差为 O(ε^{1/4})（本质误差地板），而经鲁棒 GD 精修后提升到 O(σ√ε)；鲁棒 GD 的迭代数 P=O(1)，每步用 Õ(d/ε) 新样本，故总体仍近线性。

与既有工作的对比：首次在「非单调链接 + 重尾噪声 + 强对抗污染」三者同时成立下给出近线性时间保证；样本复杂度与误差率达到当前非线性 SIM 鲁棒恢复的最好水平（与 Buna & Rebeschini 2025、Das & Batra 2026 相匹配），但样本复杂度优于 Diakonikolas et al. (2019b, 平方损失下 Õ(d⁵)) 与 (2022, 流式下 Õ(d²))。误差 O(σ√ε) 优于 Awasthi et al. (2022) 的 O(σε log(1/ε))，但后者在单调链接、仅高斯噪声下成立。

已知局限/待改进：① 误差率未达线性回归情形下的信息论最优 Õ(σε)；② 严重依赖高斯设计（ESC 推导与旋转不变性），推广到次高斯未证；③ 仅限平方损失，Huber/M-估计量下的凸盆地存在性未证；④ 仅覆盖 IE ≤ 2（GE ≤ 2）的链接，IE ≥ 3 需高阶张量方法；⑤ 依赖 ||β*||=1 的归一化假设；⑥ 纯理论工作，缺少实证验证。另有小瑕疵：Lemma 4.2 正文写 C₄ = 3(...)  而其证明给出 C₄ = 4(...)，常数不一致（不影响结论）。

Conclusion: 本文给出了理解 SIM 平方损失景观在对抗污染下结构的一个新框架，把鲁棒恢复的障碍从「非凸景观 + 污染」分解为两个可分离、可验证的充分条件：假设 2.1 负责「盆地存在且半径与维度无关」，假设 2.2（ESC）负责「盆地可达且高效」。这一分解把相位的对称二次结构推广到了任意满足 ESC 的非单调链接，并首次让 GeLU、Swish 这类现代激活函数进入可证鲁棒学习的研究范围。数值上该框架对不同链接给出可计算的一维高斯积分常数，说明其可检验性强。\n\n作者指出未来方向：缩小与信息论最优误差率 Õ(σε) 的差距；推广至非高斯/次高斯设计；考察 Huber 损失与一般 M-估计量下的凸盆地；扩展到多指数模型（需高阶张量分解）；刻画哪些链接函数存在使 IE ≤ 2 且满足两项假设的标签变换 τ（这是把框架推进到 IE ≥ 3 链接的关键）；以及最终的实证基准测试。

Abstract: We study the problem of robustly learning Gaussian Single Index Models (SIMs) in the presence of heavy-tailed noise and a constant fraction of adversarially corrupted covariates and responses. Prior work on robust recovery has considered settings such as linear regression (Pensia et al., JASA 2024), strictly monotonic link functions (Awasthi et al., NeurIPS 2022), and phase retrieval (Buna and Rebeschini, AISTATS 2025). However, these techniques do not extend to generic asymmetric non-monotonic link functions such as \textsc{GeLU} and \textsc{Swish}, which arise naturally as scalar primitives in modern gated neural architectures. We close this gap by giving the first robust recovery algorithm with near-linear sample and time complexity for generic non-monotonic link functions, thereby establishing the first robust recovery guarantees for a broad family of nonlinear SIMs for which \textit{no guarantees were previously known}. Our central contribution is a new structural understanding of the Gaussian squared-loss landscape under adversarial contamination. Crucially, we prove that for a broad class of nonlinear non-monotonic SIMs, a dimension-independent, constant-radius convex basin exists around the ground truth and is efficiently reachable via robust spectral initialization even under adversarial contamination. Prior works fail to establish both guarantees simultaneously, thereby either breaking down under adversarial contamination or failing to handle generic non-monotonic link functions. Together, these structural insights yield a principled warm start for robust gradient descent that provably converges to a final estimation error of $O(σ\sqrtε)$ in $\tilde{O}(nd)$ time with $\tilde{O}(d)$ samples, where $ε$ is the contamination fraction.

</details>


### [237] [Quotient DAGs for Off-Policy Evaluation:Forward-Flow Importance Sampling and Exact Slate Propensities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29500)
*Ziwen Xie,Shaowen Xiang,Hongyu He,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"商 DAG（quotient-DAG）"视角：把 OPE 的重要性采样从轨迹级/前缀级重写为在"对评估充分等价"的历史前缀商图上的**前向流比** F_π(z)/F_β(z)，并据此构造 Forward-Flow IS 估计器（逐决策项为 Rao–Blackwell 化，无偏且逐项方差不增，终端商下有精确方差差公式）。在自动回归 slate 推荐场景中，对"集合充分（set-sufficient）"接口的置换商即子集 DAG，Forward-DP 以 O((M+K)·2^K) 时间精确计算无序 slate 联合倾向性（免去 K! 枚举），并证明 Ω(2^K) 的子集查询下界使算法在 oracle 模型下查询最优；该原语可支撑 FF-OIS/FF-WIS/FF-DR 及 DP-MPL、DP-OPCB 扩展，实现在 Sepsis、ICU-Sepsis、KuaiRec 与离线模型选择上的一致方差降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准重要性采样按实现路径重加权，会把评估目标本不关心的生成细节当作有效信号，造成"冗余方差"；更棘手的是计算缺口：自回归 slate 日志器只暴露有序生成概率 π(σ|x)，而 slate-OPE 估计器需要无序 slate 的联合倾向性 μ(S|x)，其精确值要求对全部 K! 种生成顺序求和，因而不可行。此外 Ryser 式永久积 DP、边缘化 Plackett–Luce 闭式、Gumbel-top-K 采样等方案均假设"分数在给定上下文后固定"，无法处理下一物品 softmax 依赖已选部分 slate 的上下文相关日志器（变压器/LLM 重排器正是如此），从而在 transformer 推荐器上缺少可用的 OPE 原语。

Method: 1) 将 rollout 树按"充分等价"（定义2：同类历史的续体分布一致）商化为分层 DAG，定义前向流 F_μ(z)=P_μ[z_t=z]，用一次前向扫描递推；证明商空间似然比 dP_π^Z/dP_β^Z = F_π(z)/F_β(z)（命题3），且 E_β[ρ_{1:t-1}|z_t=z]=F_π/F_β（命题4 给出终端商下的精确方差差 = E[g²Var(ρ|q)]，有限商下化为 χ² 加权和）。2) 构造 FF-IS（式11），逐项为 PDIS 项的条件期望，故无偏且逐项方差更小（但全估计器因跨期协方差无方差序）。3) slate 特化：定义"集合充分"策略（μ(a|x,h)仅依赖已选集合 S_<t），置换商为子集 DAG；Forward-DP 在子集格上按大小递推 F^x_μ(S)=Σ_{a∈S}F^x_μ(S∖a)μ(a|x,S∖a)（命题5：前向流=联合 slate 倾向性），单个已记录 slate 仅需 2^K 节点，算术 O(K·2^K)、含策略前向查询 O((M+K)·2^K)；命题6 给出 Ω(2^K) 子集查询下界（构造未查询子集处不可区分的两个集合充分策略）。4) 变体：FF-OIS/WIS/DR、DP-MPL（由流表算入排边缘概率）、DP-OPCB（由流表算类级概率）。MDP 实验中流用日志经验商比（样本分割/留一）估计，不拟合转移模型。

Result: Sepsis 上 FF-WIS 将 RMSE 从 0.291 降至 0.0568，ICU-Sepsis 从 0.0532 降至 0.0265（均仅用日志，无需拟合模型）；DICE 系基线在这些非平稳有限时域基准上偏差主导。KuaiRec 上 Forward-DP 精确且避免阶乘枚举：K=8 时枚举需 97,108 秒而 Forward-DP 仅 8.94 秒，K=10/12 分别 12.5/13.7 秒（枚举外推约 10^7/10^10 秒）。下游 RMSE 上 FF-OIS/FF-DR 在所有 K 均优于 OIS/DR（FF-OIS/OIS 比值 0.14–0.50）。模型选择中最佳行均由 Forward-DP 供给倾向性（Tree-DR 取得最高 top-1=0.28 与 Spearman=+0.42，DP-OPCB-DR 最低 regret=0.051），FF-OIS 相对 Tree-OIS 在三项指标上全面改善。附录诊断显示 SASRec/Qwen2.5-3B 在非规范化前缀下存在中等 set-sufficiency 违例（中位最大 TVD 随 |S| 增至约 0.28/0.16，β-诱导分布更大），并给出 O(K!·ε) 的松界；固定分数 Ryser 用于上下文相关日志器时 L1 误差 0.39–0.57。

Conclusion: 商 DAG 视角统一了 OPE 的 IS 变体：恒等历史商=逐决策 IS，(状态,时间)商=有限时域 MIS，充分抽象商=known-abstraction MIS，置换轨商=slate IS；前向流比是条件 IS 的图结构特例。对集合充分的自回归 slate 日志器，Forward-DP 在 K 对数复杂度下精确给出无序 slate 联合倾向性（实践中 K≤10 可行），填补了 transformer 推荐器 slate OPE 缺失的倾向性原语，并使离线模型选择（KuaiRec 上 SASRec 与 Qwen2.5-3B 的排序随 K 迁移）无需新的在线交互。局限：需严格 set-sufficiency（顺序条件式生成器必须做集合规范化，属部署侧策略定义而非预处理）、奖励须对生成顺序不变、仍对 K 指数、K!ε 松界在实测 TVD 下无实用意义、支持性与已知随机接口假设必要；未来方向包括连续状态扩展（学习划分/核）、ε-充分商的偏差分析以及前向流权重与更强 DR 基线的结合。

Abstract: Off-policy evaluation estimates how a target policy would perform using data collected by a different behavior policy, which is crucial when online testing is costly or risky, such as in recommendation or healthcare. Standard importance sampling reweights each logged trajectory, but it can treat details of the generation process as meaningful even when the evaluation target ignores them: for example, an autoregressive slate recommender may generate an ordered sequence of items while the reward and downstream estimator depend only on the unordered slate. This creates nuisance variance and a computational gap, since exact unordered slate propensities require summing over all generation orders. We introduce a quotient-DAG view that merges histories equivalent for evaluation and assigns weights using target-to-behavior forward-flow ratios on the merged graph. For slate recommendation under a set-sufficient next-item interface, this yields Forward-DP, a subset-DAG dynamic program that computes exact unordered propensities without factorial enumeration. The resulting propensity primitive enables practical propensity-based evaluation and model selection for context-dependent autoregressive slate loggers.

</details>


### [238] [K-FinHallu: A Hallucination Detection Benchmark for Multi-Turn RAG in Korean Finance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29523)
*Eunbyeol Cho,Yunseung Lee,Mirae Kim,Jeewon Yang,Youngjun Kwak,Edward Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: K-FinHallu 是首个面向韩国金融领域「多轮 RAG」的幻觉检测基准：基于真实韩语金融文档（AI-Hub 金融/法律文档机读数据集）用 GPT-4o 模拟用户与助手生成忠实多轮对话，再按「上下文可答性」层次化分类体系（Contradictory / Unverifiable / Irrelevance / False Refusal / False Acceptance）自动化注入幻觉，并在 12 个前沿与开源 LLM 上评测。结论是：即便最强闭源模型在二分类 F1 上可达 0.86，但在四分类细粒度诊断与拒答/弃答（justified abstention）上明显失灵；经 rationale 监督 LoRA 微调的 Qwen3-8B（SFT-R）以 0.896 的四分类总体准确率超过全部基线，但 Refusal 仍是所有模型的最弱维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融场景对精确性与时效性要求极高，幻觉会带来直接资金损失、合规风险与信任崩塌，因此需要严格的领域幻觉检测基准。但现有工作存在两大缺口：(1) 缺少多轮会话式 RAG 的评测框架——金融客服以连续交互为主，存在指代消解（anaphora）、省略与隐式引用，单轮基准（如 HaluEval、RAGTruth）无法捕捉「上下文追踪失败」型幻觉（如与前几轮逻辑不一致）；(2) 缺少韩国本土语境的金融基准——既有金融幻觉基准（PHANTOM、OmniEval）以西方制度与英语为主，未覆盖韩国的전세（Jeonse）租赁制度、本地监管体系，且韩语的粘着形态与汉韩金融术语多义性无法靠简单翻译解决。此外，现有研究多只测「是否幻觉」，很少显式评测模型在证据不足时是否应当弃答（abstention）以及能否区分「正当拒答」与「错误拒答」。

Method: **任务形式化**：第 n 轮多轮 RAG 对话定义为元组 (H_n, q_n, P_n)，模型需在 H_n ∪ P_n 严格接地地生成 a_n；检测任务为给定 (H_n, q_n, P_n, a_n) 判定该轮回答是否忠实。采用**仿真式 RAG**（simulation-based RAG）：不接真实检索器，以受控文档集 P_n（K=10）替代，可系统操控证据存在性（用语义相近但缺关键信息的 hard negative 替换 gold passage），从而把检测器评测与检索系统性能解耦；仅评测 intrinsic hallucination（源忠实性），不使用模型参数化知识。

**层次化幻觉分类体系**（顶层标准为 answerability，即 H_n ∪ P_n 是否含足够证据）：可答情形下四类接地性失败——Contradictory（与文档或对话历史冲突）、Unverifiable（引入无据的外部主张/常识）、Irrelevance（事实虽在文中但与用户意图脱节）、False Refusal（有证据却拒答）；不可答情形下为 False Acceptance（证据缺失仍作答），对应正确行为 True Refusal。

**构建管线**：源语料为 AI-Hub「韩国金融与法律文档机读理解」数据集金融子集，passage 按 KURE 嵌入模型切分至 ≤1000 tokens；按源机构划分防泄漏（测试集来自金融监督院 FSS 与韩国消费者院，训练集来自不重叠机构）。忠实对话生成：用户 LLM 选候选问题并改写为含指代/省略的依赖语境问句（n≥4 时随机插入 reconfirm 复核轮），助手 LLM 基于 gold passage 与 clue text 生成接地回答（CoQA 式）。检索模拟：以去语境化问题 q̃_n 为检索键，答案性场景置入 gold/positive passage，不可答场景全部置入 hard negative（两阶段 LLM 分类器「context sufficiency」+「clue presence」过滤出双否候选，再经人工全检）。质量控制：LLM-as-a-judge 按 answerability/plausibility/correctness/diversity/coherency 五维过滤（保留测试集 74.3%、训练集 77.0%），并与 4 名人工标注者用 Gwet's AC1 校验一致性。

**幻觉注入**：按类型定位最优注入轮次（如 Contradictory 瞄准数值/金融术语密集轮），以最小编辑（1–2 个关键词/修饰语/数字）保持原句结构；测试集用 GPT-4o 与 Gemini-2.5-Flash 双源以抑制模型特定伪影，训练集仅用 GPT-4o。注入后由 LLM 评判 appropriateness 与 naturalness（1–3 分，<2 丢弃，保留 85.2%），测试集全部经人工复核修订。

**评测与微调**：轮级评测，二分类（Acc/P/R/F1）、四分类（Faithful Answer / Hallucination / False Refusal / True Refusal，报告逐类准确率并给出 Refusal 合并视图）、以及针对幻觉样本的五类成因诊断（macro-F1 + 混淆矩阵）。基线含韩语专用（kanana-2-30b-a3b、EXAONE-4.0-32B）、开源（Llama-3.1 8B/70B、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3 8B/14B/32B）与闭源（GPT-4o、GPT-5、Gemini-2.5 Flash/Pro）。另用 LoRA 在训练划分上微调 Qwen3-8B：SFT（仅标签）与 SFT-R（附加韩语模板化 rationale，置于 Qwen3 原生 <think> 块中，按「先判可答性、再评忠实性」两步推理）；ms-swift、r=8、α=32、3 epoch、lr 1e-4、8×RTX A6000 约 4 小时。

**真实性验证**：在 404 条忠实样本上让 GPT-4o 与 Gemini-2.5-Flash 自由生成（temp 0.7），由 GPT-5-mini 评判，808 条回答中 282 条为幻觉，五类幻觉均自然出现（且呈现模型特定偏置：GPT-4o 集中于 False Refusal、Gemini 集中于 False Acceptance）；另基于产业方已部署 RAG 金融服务的现场试点（2,265 条回答中 960 条被标记，434 条人工详查中 224 条确认为幻觉，外推幻觉率约 21.9%），其类型分布与本体系一致。

Result: 二分类检测：Gemini-2.5-Flash 最佳（Acc 0.864 / F1 0.860），Gemini-2.5-Pro F1 0.849，GPT-5 F1 0.823；开源最强 Qwen3-32B F1 0.732，与 GPT-4o（0.733）相当，Qwen3 家族呈稳定规模增益；韩语专用模型显著落后（EXAONE-4.0-32B F1 0.728）。存在明显精确率–召回率权衡：Llama-3.1-8B 召回最高（0.958）但精确率最低（0.520），倾向把忠实回答过度判为幻觉；Qwen3 系列相反，偏重精确率（Qwen3-32B 精确率 0.905、召回 0.614）。

四分类（逐类准确率）：Faithful 一类近乎饱和（Qwen3-8B 0.986、GPT-5 0.969），Hallucination 类模型间方差最大，Refusal 类绝大多数基线低于 0.50。GPT-5 以总体 0.855 居基线首位，Gemini-2.5-Pro 0.853、Gemini-2.5-Flash 0.845，最强开源基线 Qwen3-32B 仅 0.743。微调后 Qwen3-8B SFT-R 总体 0.896（Hallucination 0.864、Refusal 0.750、Faithful 0.972），超过全部基线，Hallucination 类由基座 0.446 提升至 0.864（超过 GPT-5）；去掉 rationale 的 SFT 为 0.822，说明 rationale 监督是关键。Refusal 仍是最弱轴：拆解后可见两类失效——开源与韩语模型常把 False Refusal 预测为 0.000（塌缩到单一拒答类型），闭源模型能识别 False Refusal 却难以把 True Refusal 视为正当弃答（GPT-5 True Refusal 仅 0.346）。

五类成因诊断（macro-F1）：难度显著高于二分类，GPT-5 0.717、Gemini-2.5-Pro 0.725 最高，Qwen3 系列 0.387→0.492 呈规模趋势，GPT-4o 仅 0.289、韩语模型与 Llama 近零；最常见混淆为 Contradictory ↔ Unverifiable（GPT-5 有 20 例 Contradictory 被判为 Unverifiable），False Acceptance 亦常被误判为 Unverifiable。对 Contradictory 四个子因的分解显示：Number Error 与 Modifier Change 的漏检率随 Qwen3 规模下降，而 Financial Term Misunderstanding 在 32B 上仍几乎无改善（如「신용대출↔담보대출」「이자율↔금리」这类语义偏移），说明表层词汇匹配不足以捕捉韩国金融术语的细微语义变化。

跨源分析：双注入源下模型强弱排序基本保持，多数类型差异在 ±10%p 内，但 Irrelevance 差异显著——GPT-4o 注入为明显偏题易检，Gemini-2.5-Flash 注入则以同一文档中的邻近信息（如问 MMF 估值准备起始时点却答该法规的生效日）作答，Gemini-2.5-Pro 在该子集由 0.93 降至 0.68。数据规模：测试集 202 条基对话 → 808 条评测样本（404 忠实 + 404 幻觉，每基对话恰注入一处幻觉，4–8 轮，平均 3.72 轮，不可答占 9.7%）；训练集 1,312 条基对话 → 2,624 条样本（不可答占 11.4%），测试/训练语料分别 272/2,732 篇文档、2,064/42,364 条查询。

Conclusion: K-FinHallu 确立了首个韩国金融多轮 RAG 幻觉检测基准，核心贡献有三：基于「上下文可答性」的层次化幻觉分类体系（显式纳入正当弃答 True Refusal 与错误拒答 False Refusal，把 abstention 提升为一等评测轴）；基于真实韩语金融文档的「忠实对话生成 + 系统化幻觉注入」自动构建管线（并能规模化产出训练划分）；以及带 rationale 监督的 8B 微调模型即可达到或超越前沿 LLM 的实用化结论。核心发现是：可信回答判定已接近饱和（二分类 F1 最高 0.86），真正瓶颈在细粒度因果诊断与弃答判断——Financial Term Misunderstanding 这一子型在模型规模增大时几乎不改善，说明需要超越表层词汇匹配的领域语义理解；同时韩语专用模型与同规模全球模型存在差距，说明「翻译式」韩语基准不足。局限包括：领域覆盖仍集中于核心板块（复杂衍生品、投行等子领域代表不足）；按设计每对话仅注入一处幻觉，无法刻画真实交互中共现/复合幻觉；对话由 LLM 模拟生成，可能携带生成器的语言模式与伪影（但五类幻觉在真实部署与前沿模型自然输出中均已观测到）；结论基于韩国监管语言与市场语境，跨语言、跨法域迁移性有限。数据以 CC-BY-NC 4.0 发布。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced financial automation through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), yet hallucinations remain a critical barrier to deployment in high-stakes environments. Existing benchmarks focus on single-turn, English-centric tasks, leaving the multi-turn dynamics and linguistic-regulatory nuances of the Korean financial domain unaddressed. We introduce K-FinHallu, the first benchmark for hallucination detection in multi-turn Korean financial RAG. We construct multi-turn dialogues from authentic Korean financial documents and inject hallucinations under a proposed hierarchical taxonomy based on context answerability that explicitly accounts for justified abstention. Benchmarking frontier and open-source LLMs as hallucination detectors, we find that even the strongest models struggle with fine-grained financial diagnostics and refusal behavior. While fine-tuning an 8B model on our training split yields performance competitive with frontier LLMs, justified abstention remains the weakest axis across all evaluated models.

</details>


### [239] [Learning to Perturb Hidden Representations for Generalizable Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29525)
*Hua Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出「Learning to Perturb Activations (LPA)」：把深度网络中的隐藏激活（hidden activation）首次纳入统一的"扰动"分析框架，论证 Dropout、Manifold Mixup、对抗特征扰动等方法本质上都是类别无关的激活扰动实例；并据此提出按类别学习式扰动某一隐藏层激活的方法 LPA（用 PGD 在 ℝ^{d_l} 高维空间中为每个类别学习正/负增广扰动），在平衡分类、长尾分类与域泛化三类任务上稳定优于 LPL、ISDA、Dropout 等基线，且与 logit 级扰动（LPL）互补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络前向传播是一条"输入特征 → 隐藏激活 → logits → 损失"的级联管线。已有文献系统研究了输入级（数据增广、对抗训练）、logit 级（Label Smoothing、Logit Adjustment、LPL）和标签级（Mixup）扰动，但占据网络绝大部分计算的中间隐藏激活从未被统一地当作"扰动"来审视。事实上，Dropout、DropBlock、Spatial Dropout、Shake-Shake/ShakeDrop、Manifold Mixup、ISDA、ADA 等广泛使用的方法都在隐式地扰动隐藏激活，但它们各自独立发展、动机各异（正则化、鲁棒性、泛化），且扰动形式与位置固定、类别无关（class-agnostic）——例如 Dropout 对所有类施加近似相同比例的扰动，ADA 只做"扩張式"正向增广，无法针对需要压缩的类别做"收缩式"负向增广，在类别不平衡场景下失效。作者因此希望：①建立隐藏激活扰动的统一形式化框架；②揭示扰动的"扩张/收缩"与"扰动所在层"如何分别对应正/负增广与输入级/logit级效果；③在此基础上设计类别自适应、层自适应的扰动学习算法。

Method: 【1. 统一框架】定义激活扰动 ã_i^{(l)} = a_i^{(l)} + δ_i^{(l)}，δ∈ℝ^{d_l}，并把现有方法写成该形式：Dropout 为 δ = a⊙(m−1) 的样本级随机乘性扰动；Manifold Mixup 为 δ = λ(a_j − a_i) 的跨样本插值扰动；ADA 为 argmax_{‖δ‖≤ε} l(f_{l+1:L}(a+δ), y) 的样本级确定性最速上升扰动。三者均为类别无关策略。

【2. 三个猜想】C1 扩张式扰动（沿损失上升方向增大激活范数）等价于对该类做正增广（扩大类内表示分布、推远决策边界）；C2 收缩式扰动（沿损失下降方向减小激活范数）等价于负增广（压缩表示分布、降低对决策边界影响）；C3 扰动层决定效果性质：浅层主要改变低层特征多样性（类比输入增广），深层主要改变语义类别关系（类比 logit 扰动）。作者强调激活扰动空间维度 d_l ≫ 类别数 C，能实现 logit 扰动无法做到的类内精细控制。

【3. LPA 算法】选定扰动层 l 后，目标为：对正增广类集合 P_a 取扰动损失的 max（向外推决策边界），对负增广类集合 N_a 取 min（向内压缩）。δ̃_c^{(l)} 通过 PGD 求解，梯度取类内平均 ∂l/∂a^{(l)}：正增广类取 +（类平均梯度），负增广类取 −，每步投影回 ℓ2 球 ‖δ‖≤ε_c，T=3 步，步长 κ=2ε/T。为降低中间层高维开销，提出低秩变体：对类平均梯度做 SVD，仅保留 top-k 奇异方向（k=d_l/4），性能相当而显存与算力约减半。扰动界的类依赖形式为 ε_c = ε + Δε·|τ − s̄_c|，并叠加层缩放 γ_l = β^{L−l}（β<1，默认 0.7），因浅层扰动会被后续层放大（Lipschitz 常数 K_l 更大）而需更小扰动。

【4. 类别划分】沿用 LPL：平衡分类中准确率低于均值的类归入 P_a；长尾中稀有类归入 P_a；域泛化中所有类均做正增广。

【5. 层选择】固定层通常取中深层（ResNet stage 3 输出）最佳；自适应策略周期性度量各候选层带来的平均损失变化并取最大者；多层同时扰动收益边际但训练开销约 2.5 倍。

【6. 理论】命题1：激活扰动等价于该层参数的结构化扰动 ΔW^{(l)}（使 φ(ΔW a)≈δ），故 LPA 相当于最小化结构化邻域内的最坏损失（类比 SAM），收敛到相对于扰动层参数的平坦极小。命题2：‖f(a+δ)−f(a)‖ ≤ K_l·ε，扰动经层数放大，浅层放大更强，佐证 γ_l 缩放。命题3：l=L 时 LPA 退化为 LPL；l<L 时扰动经 W^{(l+1:L)} 映射为 logit 扰动，由于 d_l>C，可达 logit 扰动集合是 LPL 的严格超集，故 LPA 是 LPL 的严格推广。

Result: 【平衡分类，CIFAR-10/100 Top-1 错误率】LPA(mean+varied) 在 WRN-28-10 上为 3.06%（CIFAR-10）/16.48%（CIFAR-100），ResNet-110 上为 4.82% / 21.92%；CIFAR-100+ResNet-110 上较 LPL 的 22.65% 提升 0.73 个百分点。全面优于 CE、Label Smoothing、Mixup、ISDA、LPL、Dropout、DropBlock、Manifold Mixup。低秩版 LPA-lowrank 为 4.86%/22.01%，接近全秩但成本更低。

【长尾分类】CIFAR-100-LT（不平衡比 100:1）上 LPA 取得 34.2% 总体准确率，超过 LPL 5.4%、超过 LPG 2.2%；尾部类提升最显著，符合"扩张尾部类激活=正增广"的猜想。

【域泛化（DomainBed, ResNet-50）】LPA 在 PACS 87.8 / VLCS 79.1 / OfficeHome 69.5 / TerraIncognita 49.0，四个基准全部超过 ERM、DANN、CORAL、Mixup、Manifold Mixup、RSC 以及专为域泛化设计的 SWAD（48.2）。

【可组合性】LPA 可作插件：ISDA+LPA、LPL+LPA、Dropout+LPA 均优于各自基线；LPL+LPA 在 CIFAR-100（WRN-28-10）达到 16.05% 错误率最优，证实 logit 与激活层扰动互补。

【架构泛化】CIFAR-100 上 ResNet-32 24.85%、SE-ResNet-110 21.02%、WRN-16-8 16.48%，均优于 ISDA 与 LPL，ResNet-32（表示空间最受限）收益最大。

【分析性结果】扰动层消融显示 stage 3 输出最优、stage 4（logit 层）复现 LPL、stage 1 因后续信息覆盖而较差；t-SNE 显示 LPA 尾部类簇更紧致、类间间隔更大；Grad-CAM 显示关注区域更广更具判别性；超参鲁棒（ε∈[0.05,0.3]、β∈[0.5,0.8]、保留 25% 梯度方向即可保住大部分收益，ε>0.5 因过扰动而退化）。

【训练开销】stage 3 扰动 + T=3 时训练时间约 +18%，低秩版约 +12%，低于 SAM 的约 +30%；开销随扰动点之后的层数增长，故深层扰动更高效。

Conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是：①首次把隐藏激活纳入统一扰动框架，将 Dropout、Manifold Mixup、对抗特征扰动等归结为类别无关的激活扰动实例；②提出并论证三条猜想——扩张/收缩扰动分别对应正/负增广，扰动层决定效果更接近输入级还是 logit 级；③提出 LPA，在选定隐藏层以类别级、层自适应界、自适应扰动强度（PGD 学方向与幅度、低秩 SVD 降维）进行学习式扰动；④理论上将激活扰动与平坦极小、SAM 式结构化参数扰动、跨层扰动放大（Lipschitz 界）联系起来，并证明 LPA 是 LPL 的严格推广（l=L 时等价，l<L 时可达 logit 扰动超集）；⑤在平衡分类、长尾分类、域泛化三场景中一致优于现有方法，且与 LPL 互补叠加。局限与展望：类别级扰动粒度仍不够细，样本级个性化扰动可进一步提升但计算代价高；层选择策略有望用基于梯度的架构搜索自动化；未来可研究多层/多级（输入-激活-logit-标签）扰动的联合最优组合。

Abstract: Deep neural networks process data through a cascade of representations: input features, hidden activations, logits, and loss. While perturbations at the input, logit, and label levels have been systematically studied, the intermediate hidden activations, which constitute the bulk of the network's computation, have received no unified perturbation analysis. In this paper, we establish a unified framework for hidden activation perturbation, revealing that Dropout, Manifold Mixup, adversarial feature perturbation, and related methods all impose specific forms of activation perturbation but with class-agnostic or random strategies. We conjecture that expansive perturbation (increasing activation norm) acts as positive augmentation, while contractive perturbation (decreasing activation norm) acts as negative augmentation, and that the perturbation layer determines whether the effect resembles input-level augmentation (shallow layers) or logit-level manipulation (deep layers). We propose Learning to Perturb Activations (LPA), which adaptively perturbs activations at a selected hidden layer with class-level perturbations learned via PGD. We further provide theoretical analysis connecting activation perturbation to flat minima and perturbation amplification through layers. Experiments on balanced classification, long-tail classification, and domain generalization demonstrate that LPA consistently outperforms existing methods and provides complementary benefits to logit perturbation methods such as LPL.

</details>


### [240] [AsymVLM: Asymmetric Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29535)
*Yilin Feng,Ahmed Burak Gulhan,Mahmut Taylan Kandemir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AsymVLM 提出一种"非对称"视觉-语言模型（VLM）推理压缩框架：针对视觉 token 采用"prefill 前激进的剪枝"（学习到的输出感知重要性打分器 + 逐样本自适应预算），针对文本 token 采用"decoding 阶段超预算才触发的阈值驱逐"，在 Phi-3.5-Vision 与 Gemma 3 上取得最高达 54% 的 FLOPs 节省，在 DocVQA/ChartQA 等文档与图表理解任务上比 FastV/SparseVLM 高 2–3%，并在多轮/自由生成场景显著优于 H2O、StreamingLLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 压缩方法对视觉 token 与文本 token 采用统一策略，忽视了两者本质差异：视觉 token 数量庞大（Phi-3.5-Vision 每图 2500 个）、空间高度冗余、彼此无因果依赖，主要占据 prefill 计算与显存瓶颈；文本 token 由自回归生成、严格因果依赖、随解码累积，在自由生成与多轮对话中反超视觉 token 成为瓶颈。此外，现有视觉剪枝方法（FastV、SparseVLM、FlashVLM、VisPruner）仅依赖注意力模式或语义/显著性相似度等输入侧信号，且对所有样本使用固定剪枝比例，无法反映样本间难度差异（例如"表格上方下划线标题"仅需局部信息，而"有多少个方框插图"需全局扫描）。作者由此提出核心问题：视觉与文本 token 是否应共享同一压缩策略？答案为否——视觉压缩本质是"输入选择"问题，文本压缩本质是"缓存管理"问题。

Method: 框架包含三个组件。(1) 学习的视觉 token 重要性打分器：在交叉模态相似度基础上引入可学习的逐维权重 w，对 ℓ2 归一化的视觉与文本嵌入做逐维缩放后计算相似度矩阵 S=(V̂⊙w)T̂ᵀ，取每行最大值作为重要性 s_i；w=1 时退化为余弦相似度。打分器以最小化剪枝后与未剪枝前向的末层文本位置隐状态 MSE 为主损失（L=Σ‖h_masked−h_baseline‖²+λ‖w−1‖²，λ=0.001），配合 soft score masking（对注意力 logit 加 m_i=−C·sigmoid((θ−s_i)/τ) 惩罚，θ 可微性截断、跨层共享）使梯度能回传；仅更新 w，模型全部冻结，在 DocVQA 1500 样本上训练 3 epoch（AdamW, lr=1e-3, C=5.0, τ=1.0, w 裁剪至[0,3]）。(2) 逐样本自适应预算：定义重要性 gap g=s^(k)−s^(N−k+1)（k=⌊N/4⌋，即上下四分位边界差），Method A 用两个阈值 g_lo/g_hi 将样本分为保守/中等/激进三档保持比（网格搜索于500样本校准集），Method B 学习线性映射 r(g)=clamp(r_target+a(g−ḡ), r_min, r_max)，默认采用 Method A。(3) 阈值式文本 token 驱逐：仅当生成 token 数超过固定预算（LLaVA-Bench 90，MMDU 512）才触发，单轮场景用当前步最后一层跨头平均注意力评估重要性，多轮场景按与当前图像的跨模态相似度在"回答轮"粒度驱逐、保留所有问题与图像 token，prefill token 全部无条件保护。整体流程为在 Transformer 之前完成两阶段视觉剪枝，保证所有层与注意力头看到一致的 token 集合。

Result: Phi-3.5-Vision 上，AsymVLM 在 75%/65%/50% 视觉 token 保持比下分别节省 28%/39%/54% FLOPs，并带来 44%–75% 峰值显存下降与 25%–50% KV cache 下降；FastV 因只做注意力掩码无任何 FLOPs/显存节省，SparseVLM 早期层仍处理全部 token 故显存与 KV 无节省。精度上 DocVQA 85.75/85.07/83.22（ANLS），75% 时比 FastV 高 2.2%、65% 时高 3.3%；ChartQA 在 75%/65% 保持比下 68.0/67.8 不低于全 token 基线 67.4；MME、TextVQA、OCRVQA 与基线方法相当。打分器消融显示 50% 保持比下学习打分器在 DocVQA 达 83.22，而交叉相似度仅 68.04、螺旋位置排序 55.39；OCRVQA 73.20 vs 56.60 vs 51.80。自适应预算在 70%–50% 平均预算下均优于同预算均匀剪枝（DocVQA 如 65% 预算 85.31 vs 84.25，60% 预算 83.83 vs 83.22，50% 预算 80.30 vs 78.50），阈值分档增益 1.8–3.8%。Gemma 3 文本驱逐：LLaVA-Bench 在 90%/75%/50% 保持 75.69/75.33/74.69（基线 79），远优于 H2O（75.3→69.83）与 StreamingLLM（58.33→53.0）；MMDU 上 90% 保持得 7.03（甚至超过基线 6.80），50% 保持即 6.80 等于基线，而 H2O/StreamingLLM 降至 5.02/4.95。打分器仅用 1500 个 DocVQA 样本训练即可跨基准泛化。

Conclusion: 视觉 token 与文本 token 应被视为性质迥异的压缩对象：视觉 token 应在进入 Transformer 之前做"查询感知、输出感知"的激进前剪枝，文本 token 则应在解码阶段做"超预算才触发、保护 prefill 与视觉上下文"的轻量驱逐。AsymVLM 证明非对称、模态感知的压缩在 FLOPs、显存与 KV cache 三方面均优于 FastV、SparseVLM，并在文档/图表理解任务上取得 2–3% 精度提升，文本驱逐在短上下文 VLM 中远优于面向长上下文的 H2O/StreamingLLM。局限性：仅在 Phi-3.5-Vision 与 Gemma 3 上验证，向 LLaMA 系、Qwen-VL 等架构的泛化性待确认；文本驱逐使用固定阈值、不随对话难度自适应，且未在 50 轮以上的超长多轮对话上测试；另需注意 DocVQA 评测包含用于训练打分器的 1500 个样本（作者称剔除后结果几乎不变）。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) process thousands of visual tokens per image alongside comparatively few text tokens, yet existing compression methods treat both modalities uniformly. We observe that the two modalities have fundamentally different properties: vision tokens are spatially redundant and dominate prefill, while text tokens are causally dependent and accumulate during decoding. Based on this asymmetry, we propose and empirically evaluate AsymVLM, which applies aggressive pruning to vision tokens before prefill using a learned importance scorer with per-sample adaptive budgeting, and temporal threshold-based eviction to text tokens only when they exceed a fixed budget. Our experiments indicate that AsymVLM achieves the highest FLOPs savings (up to 54%) among state-of-the-art methods while outperforming existing approaches by 2--3% on document and chart understanding tasks where visual information is spatially localized and query-specific, and maintaining competitive accuracy on holistic benchmarks. In text-dominated scenarios, our eviction strategy substantially outperforms standard LLM cache compression methods by adapting to the short-context nature of VLM.

</details>


### [241] [Singularity-aware Optimization via Randomized Geometric Probing: Towards Stable Non-smooth Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29547)
*Ruoran Xu,Borong She,Xiaobo Jin,Qiufeng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Singularity-aware Adam（S-Adam）：用随机方向导数方差的归一化比值构造"局部几何不稳定性"（LGI）指标 ρ_t 来无 Hessian 地估计 Clarke 次梯度集直径，并以"几何刹车" exp(−λρ_t) 缩放 Adam 的有效步长，使更新在奇异点附近被抑制、在光滑区域退化为标准 Adam。作者用微分包含（differential inclusion）证明其几乎必然收敛到 (δ,ε)-Clarke 稳定点，迭代复杂度 O(1/ε²)。实验覆盖低比特 QAT（CIFAR-100 2-bit、TinyImageNet/Imagewoof2-160 4-bit、ImageNet 8-bit）与 ResNet18 小批量高噪声训练，S-Adam 全面优于 AdamW 与 Prox-SGD（如 Imagewoof2-160 批大小 2 时 +24.69 个百分点），且额外前向开销仅约 1.4%（k=2 时甚至快于 AdamW）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代深度网络大量使用 ReLU、量化算子（QAT）、稀疏正则等非光滑组件，使损失面在几乎处处局部 Lipschitz 但在奇异点梯度未定义。Adam 等自适应优化器依赖二阶矩估计隐含的"局部光滑"假设，在奇异点处二阶矩滞后于急剧变化的几何结构，累积相互冲突的 Clarke 子梯度方向，产生"梯度颤振"（gradient chattering），导致振荡、收敛差与泛化下降。已有补救均不足：近端方法需要可计算的近端映射，而 QNN 中量化/ReLU/稀疏项的嵌套组合无闭式近端算子；随机平滑作为梯度代理会引入偏差与高方差并改变优化轨迹；SAM 依赖一阶 Taylor 展开，在不可微点失效；梯度裁剪、warmup、方差缩减等启发式无法区分随机噪声与真正的拓扑奇异。核心动机是：需要一种能在线感知"局部几何不稳定度"、计算廉价且不改变梯度方向的机制。

Method: **1. 几何框架（Clarke 分析）**：定义 Clarke 次微分 ∂_C f(x) 为所有极限梯度的凸包，其直径 diam(∂_C f(x)) 刻画非光滑严重程度；大直径即梯度颤振的几何根源。

**2. LGI 指标**：ρ_t = Var_{u_i}[D_i] / (Mean[D_i²]+ε)，其中 D_i = [f(x_t+δu_i) − f(x_t)]/δ，u_i ~ U(S^{d−1}) i.i.d.，δ 为扰动尺度，ε>0 保数值稳定。该指标无需 Hessian；附录 E 用随机平滑的 Taylor 展开给出双重解释：ρ(x) ≈ (1+κ_δ²/2d)/(1+κ_δ²/2d+ε′)，即等价于平滑后景观的"相对曲率" κ_δ = δ‖∇²f_δ‖_F/‖∇f_δ‖，故非光滑区 ↔ 高曲率 → ρ→1。

**3. S-Adam 更新**：先做 k 次随机探测算 LGI，再按标准 Adam 更新 m_t、v_t，并用 η̂_t = η_t·exp(−λρ_t) 缩放步长，w_{t+1} = w_t − η̂_t·m_t/(√v_t+ε)。λ 控制阻尼强度，k 控制成本-保真度权衡，δ 决定探针"探测半径"。

**4. 理论保证**：
- Proposition 4.1 / 附录 A：0 ≤ ρ_t < 1，故 e^{−λ} < exp(−λρ_t) ≤ 1，均值阻尼系数 ᾱ(x) ≥ e^{−λ} > 0（"非退化"），保证更新不会完全停滞。
- Lemma 4.2 / 附录 C：基于 Hoeffding 不等式与均值-方差误差分解，给出有限样本估计保证 |ρ̂_k − ρ| ≤ Δ 的置信度 1−δ，样本复杂度 k = O(L⁶ε⁻⁴Δ⁻² log(1/δ))。
- Theorem 5.5（微分包含框架，Benaïm 1996 / Benaim et al. 2006）：在局部 Lipschitz、有下界、路径可微、迭代有界、步长满足 Robbins–Monro、矩估计一致等假设下，S-Adam 几乎必然满足 liminf_t dist(0, ∂_C f(x_t)) = 0，并在 O(1/ε²) 次迭代内达到 ε-稳定点；O(1/ε²) 匹配非光滑随机优化的最优复杂度。证明路线为：写成微分包含的随机逼近形式 → 仿射插值构造渐近伪轨迹（APT）→ 用 Clarke 链规则证明 f 为严格 Lyapunov（df/dt ≤ −ᾱc₁·dist²(0,∂_C f)）→ 不变集原理得极限集 ⊆ Λ = {x: 0 ∈ ∂_C f(x)}。

**5. 与近端方法的关系（附录 D）**：exp(−λρ_t) ≈ 1/(1+λρ_t) ≈ η_t/(η_tγ_t+1)，γ_t = λρ_t/η_t，故 S-Adam 可视为带几何自适应正则的隐式近端法。

**6. 稳定性分析（附录 F）**：用 Bousquet–Elisseeff 一致稳定性定理，证明 LGI 差异 |ρ_t − ρ'_t| = O(1/b)，从而 β_{S-Adam} ≤ (max_t α_t)·C_Adam，即 S-Adam 的泛化间隙界被几何刹车进一步收紧。

**实验设计**：QATNet 自定义 CNN（权重/激活 2/4/8-bit 模拟量化，round+clamp autograd）；ResNet18 预训练主干 + 批大小 {2,4,16,64} 制造高梯度噪声；对照 AdamW 与 Prox-SGD，固定种子 42，δ=0.01，λ_LGI=2.0，LGI 上限 10.0，NVIDIA A800；报告各 epoch 最优测试精度。

Result: **QAT（表1）**：S-Adam 在全部四个数据集上领先。CIFAR-100（2-bit）18.11%(k=2)/18.67%(k=8) vs AdamW 15.94%、Prox-SGD 14.13%；TinyImageNet（4-bit）22.81/23.18% vs 18.91/19.89%；Imagewoof2-160（4-bit）35.57/35.19% vs 33.24/31.18%；ImageNet（8-bit）Top-1 10.97/11.24% vs 8.63/8.63%。收敛时间：Prox-SGD 在 CIFAR-100 上不收敛（*），AdamW 15.89s vs S-Adam 14.33s（k=2）；ImageNet 上 8297s vs 8186s，仅 1.4% 开销。

**超参消融（表2）**：λ=0 时显著退化（TinyImageNet -4.9%），确认阻尼必要；k=1 时方差信号消失、退化为 AdamW（CIFAR-100 15.86%）；k=2→k=8 提升有限，说明 2 次探测已捕获主要几何信号；δ=0.0001 过小则探测"够不到"量化边界，CIFAR-100 跌至 14.78%。

**损失/精度曲线（图4、5）**：CIFAR-100 上 Prox-SGD 反弹至 ~4.6 且大幅震荡、AdamW 后期上漂；S-Adam 稳定在 3.4–3.6。TinyImageNet 上 S-Adam 损失下界 3.0–3.2 优于基线 3.4–3.5。精度呈单调上升而非"钟形"崩塌（基线在第 3 epoch 见顶后跌至 <10%）。

**小批量高噪声（表3，BS=2）**：CIFAR-100 56.11% vs AdamW 51.12%（+4.99）；CIFAR-10 86.13% vs 80.48%；Imagewoof2-160 75.87% vs 51.18%（+24.69）。k=2 时收敛时间仍快于 AdamW（CIFAR-100 2136.5s vs 2317.0s）。

**批大小扫描（表4）**：BS=4 时 Imagewoof 81.22% vs AdamW 56.25%（约+20）；BS=16 时 CIFAR-100 74.43% 超 Prox-SGD 6% 以上；BS=64 时优势收窄（CIFAR-10 94.18% vs 90.62%），与"批大→景观平滑→LGI 下降→刹车放松"的机制预期一致。

**学习率敏感性（表5）**：CIFAR-100/BS=2 下 lr∈{1e-4,5e-4,1e-3} 时 S-Adam 分别领先 AdamW +4.02/+8.28/+4.99，最佳 70.87% vs 66.85%，说明增益不是单一调参产物。

**数值不一致**：摘要称"CIFAR-100 最高 +6%、TinyImageNet +3%"，而正文结论为 QAT +2.17~+3.90、小批量 +4.99/+24.69，摘要与正文口径不一致；附录 D 与附录 E 的推导存在符号混用（如 Eq.(67) 中 e^{−η_t(λ/η_t ρ_t)} 与 e^{−λρ_t} 的对应写法不严谨）。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是把"随机平滑"从梯度代理重新定位为几何诊断探针：用极少量额外前向传播估计局部 Clarke 几何不稳定性，并据此在线调制自适应优化器的步长，从而在不改变梯度方向、不引入 Hessian 代价的前提下抑制非光滑区域的振荡。与 Prox-SGD（需闭式近端映射）、随机平滑代理（偏差/方差）、SAM（在奇异点 Taylor 失效）相比，S-Adam 是可即插即用的 Adam 变体，具备：(1) 无 Hessian 的 LGI 估计与有限样本复杂度保证；(2) 阻尼系数非退化（≥e^{−λ}）的下界保证；(3) 基于微分包含与严格 Lyapunov 的 Clarke 稳定点收敛证明与最优 O(1/ε²) 复杂度；(4) 统一稳定性分析给出的泛化间隙上界随几何刹车收紧。实验表明增益集中在"最不稳定的极端非光滑 + 高噪声"区域（低比特 QAT、BS=2/4），在景观平滑后自然退化回 Adam，说明该机制是按局部几何而非全局超参起作用的。局限方面：(i) 理论的关键一环"下降对齐"不等式 ⟨ξ_t, h_t⟩ ≥ c₁·dist²(0,∂_C f) 及 Assumption 5.4 的矩估计一致性是较强假设，实际有限差分探测（k=2、δ=0.01）在高维下有偏且方差大，LGI 与真实 Clarke 直径仅是近似关系；(ii) 由 min dist² ≤ O(T^{−1/2}) 到 O(1/ε²) 迭代的推导存在量纲不一致（严格按 dist ≤ ε 需 T = O(ε^{−4})），"最优 O(1/√T) 速率"的表述宜更精确；(iii) 额外 k 次前向传播在大模型/大 batch 场景的墙钟开销、以及 λ、δ 与模型规模的耦合仍需更多验证；(iv) 摘要与结论的增益数字口径不统一，Prox-SGD 基线的具体形式与调参细节披露有限。未来方向包括面向架构类型的专用几何签名、基于 LGI 的自动非光滑区检测与优化器切换，以及将几何不稳定性作为泛化差距的预测指标。

Abstract: Deep learning optimization relies heavily on the assumption of smooth loss landscapes, a condition systematically violated by modern architectures due to non-smooth components such as ReLU activations and quantization operators. In such non-smooth regimes, adaptive optimizers such as Adam suffer from gradient chattering, violent oscillations caused by conflicting signals within the Clarke subdifferential, leading to poor convergence and suboptimal generalization. To address this, we introduce Singularity-aware Adam (S-Adam), a novel optimizer that stabilizes training by dynamically modulating step sizes based on local geometric instability. Our key contribution is the Local Geometric Instability (LGI) metric, a computationally efficient estimator of the Clarke subdifferential diameter derived from the variance of randomized directional derivatives. S-Adam incorporates an adaptive damping mechanism exp(-$λ$$ρ$) that decelerates updates in high-instability regions while preserving fast convergence in smooth basins. We provide a rigorous convergence analysis using differential inclusions, proving that S-Adam converges almost surely to ($δ$,$ε$)-Clarke stationary points at the optimal O(1/$\sqrt(T)$) rate. Empirical evaluations on Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) and high-noise small-batch learning demonstrate that S-Adam consistently outperforms AdamW and Prox-SGD, achieving accuracy gains of up to 6 percent on CIFAR-100 and 3 percent on TinyImageNet while effectively mitigating gradient oscillations.

</details>


### [242] [Why Larger Models Learn More: Effects of Capacity, Interference, and Rare-Task Retention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29548)
*Jing Huang,Daniel Wurgaft,Rachit Bansal,Laura Ruis,Naomi Saphra,David Alvarez-Melis,Andrew Kyle Lampinen,Christopher Potts,Ekdeep Singh Lubana*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Larger models learn tasks smaller models do not. What drives this phenomenon? We develop a simple phenomenological argument that power-law scaling already suggests that a larger model will be able to learn a part of the data distribution that a smaller model fails to learn, even with infinite training data. To validate this claim and identify its causes, we study the effects of model scaling on a synthetic setup consisting of a mixture of tasks that show monotonic scaling curves. The results point to a data-induced competition over resources (neurons). Specifically, smaller models allocate their neurons to high frequency or low complexity tasks, and so they learn solutions that perform poorly on rare and complex tasks. Moreover, this happens even when solutions capable of expressing the desired task exist. We then assess how a larger model circumvents this data-centric bottleneck, finding that it traces to a reduced interference mechanism: larger models can allocate enough resources to common tasks that the gradient updates for those tasks become weak, which means that they do not overwrite rare-task features as they slowly accumulate. Finally, to further validate these claims, we pretrain OLMo models (4M to 4B parameters) on novel tasks of varying frequency and complexity. The results mirror those from our synthetic data experiments: only the larger OLMo models learn the infrequent and complex tasks, and these larger models embed more task features in their representations and show less gradient interference between tasks. Overall, we offer a data-centric account of why larger models learn tasks that smaller models fail to. This helps explain why larger models are better in practice, and it can inform practical questions concerning model sizing and training data mixtures.

### [243] [On the Construction and Implications of Low-Loss Valleys in LoRA-based Bayesian Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29580)
*Daniel Dold,Emanuel Sommer,Julius Kobialka,Oliver Dürr,David Rügamer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods like low-rank adaptation (LoRA) are standard for large language models, principled estimation of epistemic uncertainty remains challenging. Recent results in the LoRA regime suggest that discrete multi-mode approaches such as deep ensembles offer little benefit over single-mode methods. This contradicts broader observations in deep learning, where ensembling independent optima typically improves generalization, and linking these modes through continuous low-loss valleys further enhances Bayesian model averaging (BMA). Whether such structure exists in the LoRA space and whether it yields functional diversity missed by local or discrete methods has not been studied. We introduce LoRA-Curve, a segmented Bézier curve parameterization in the LoRA space, with two variants: a free configuration that jointly optimizes all control points, and an anchored configuration that connects independently fine-tuned LoRA optima. We prove pathwise continuity and Lipschitz regularity of the loss along the curve and empirically show, across reasoning and classification benchmarks with Qwen2.5 7B, that linear interpolation encounters loss barriers, while our anchored multi-segment curves connect independent optima through continuous low-loss valleys. Combined with flat-minima perturbations and a Jensen-Shannon divergence regularizer, LoRA-Curve yields measurably higher mutual information of the predictive distribution without sacrificing performance, and links continuous parameter-space traversal to functional diversity.

### [244] [PEARL: Training Socratic Tutors with Pedagogically Aligned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29582)
*Qikai Chang,Zhenrong Zhang,Linbo Chen,Pengfei Hu,Jianshu Zhang,Youhui Guo,Jun Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise as educational tutors, yet effective tutoring requires more than solving problems: it must provide progressive Socratic guidance and balance multiple pedagogical objectives across multi-turn interactions. However, training such tutors remains challenging due to limited-fidelity and weakly controllable student simulation, under-specified pedagogical reward modeling, and unstable multi-objective optimization. To overcome these limitations, we propose PEARL, a pedagogically aligned reinforcement learning framework for training Socratic tutoring agents, consisting of three key components. First, we introduce a controllable student simulator that decouples latent cognitive states from response generation to model diverse abilities and misconceptions. Second, we develop a generative reward model that jointly evaluates pedagogical quality and objective correctness for policy optimization. Finally, we propose a stable multi-objective RL scheme that discretizes rewards within each dimension and aggregates normalized advantages across dimensions, preventing high-variance objectives from dominating updates. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that PEARL achieves the best performance among open-source models and remains competitive with leading proprietary LLMs, despite using only a 30B policy model.

### [245] [Cluster-Level Attention-Guided Parallel Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29607)
*Heqiang Qi,Wei Huang,Mingyuan Bai,Xiangming Meng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) enable parallel decoding by predicting all masked positions at each denoising step, yet existing training-free samplers usually decide which positions to commit at token-level granularity. We revisit this granularity and observe that reliable predictions often emerge as contiguous high-confidence spans, suggesting that the unit of parallel commitment can be larger than a single token. We first group adjacent high-confidence candidates into confidence-induced clusters (CICs) as span-level update units. We then use self-attention maps from the same forward pass to estimate inter-cluster dependencies, enabling conflict-aware selection of mutually compatible CICs for parallel commitment. This yields CLAD (Cluster-Level Attention-Guided Decoding), a training-free cluster-level decoder for MDLMs. Experiments on LLaDA and Dream model families across four reasoning and code-generation benchmarks show that CLAD achieves 1.77x--8.47x speedups over Vanilla decoding while maintaining broadly comparable task accuracy in most settings.

### [246] [MōLe-Λ: Learning the Coupled-Cluster Response State for Energies, Gradients, and Properties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29622)
*Andreas Burger,Luca Thiede,Abdulrahman Aldossary,Jorge A. Campos-Gonzalez-Angulo,Alex Zook,Jérôme Florian Gonthier,Alán Aspuru-Guzik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Coupled-cluster (CC) theory is often considered the gold standard of quantum chemistry, but its high computational cost limits routine access to accurate energies, forces and response properties. While the right-hand $T$-amplitudes determine the correlated wavefunction, many practically important observables additionally require the left-hand $Λ$-amplitudes. We introduce MōLe-$Λ$, an extension of Molecular Orbital Learning (MōLe) that predicts the full ground-state coupled-cluster singles and doubles (CCSD) response state by jointly learning right-hand amplitudes $(T_1,T_2)$ and left-hand amplitudes $(Λ_1,Λ_2)$ from localized Hartree--Fock molecular orbitals. Architecturally, MōLe-$Λ$ extends MōLe with $Λ_1$ and $Λ_2$ readouts that mirror the symmetry constraints of the $T_1$ and $T_2$ heads, while preserving the original equivariant orbital encoder, odd sign-equivariant decoding, locality and size-extensivity. The resulting model yields accurate CC-quality energies and forces, while simultaneously recovering dipoles, quadrupoles, polarizabilities, the electron density, and 2-electron observables such as the pair density. We show that MōLe-$Λ$ further extends the speed advantage of MōLe over full CCSD while substantially expanding the accessible properties, providing a route to wavefunction-level surrogate models for correlated quantum chemistry.

### [247] [Relational Rank Geometry in Transformers: Detecting and Steering Hidden-State Relation Frames](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29634)
*Mazen Kobrosly*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Transformer hidden states are often interpreted through local or low-order objects: neurons, sparse features, attention heads, residual-stream directions, or activation patches. This paper studies a complementary object: the rank-indexed geometry of relations among token tuples. I use Plucker sign entropy to test whether r-argument relations leave arity-matched orientation signatures in hidden-state space. Across Llama-family 8B, 70B, and 405B checkpoints, true relation tuples show stronger orientation-sign consistency at the expected rank k=r for r=3,...,6 than scrambled tuples under matched random-control audits. Multi-template audits show that the effects survive surface variation, with all tested 405B rows retaining positive expected-rank margins and 8B/70B retaining positive rows with constructor-specific mixed cells. I then ask whether the same relation geometry can be steered. In an edge-grid clean/corrupt intervention assay over 32 prompts, the row/column scaffold and answer format stay fixed while the YES/NO relation map changes, and the corrupt hidden-state relation frame is patched toward clean or placebo targets. In 70B and 405B, clean-targeted relation-frame paths recover clean-answer behavior and residual relation geometry, while centroid-only and equal-norm controls show negligible recovery. Site/order controls further separate marker-site importance from ordered clean-frame geometry: target clean shape and cross-prompt clean shape recover behavior and residual geometry at the marker interface, whereas corrupt-donor transfer, same-site permutation/reflection, wrong-site clean deltas, centroid-only motion, and equal-norm noise fail or remain far below clean-frame paths. The result is a controlled bridge from relation probing to relation-frame intervention: relation rank geometry can be detected, targeted, and behaviorally validated in transformer hidden states.

### [248] [The Sample Complexity of Multiclass and Sparse Contextual Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29645)
*Liad Erez,Fan Chen,Alon Cohen,Tomer Koren,Yishay Mansour,Shay Moran,Alexander Rakhlin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We study contextual bandits in the stochastic i.i.d.\ setting, where a learner observes contexts drawn from an unknown distribution, selects actions from a finite set $A$, and aims to identify an approximately optimal policy from a given class based on bandit feedback. Motivated by bandit multiclass classification with zero-one rewards, we focus on the \emph{$s$-sparse} setting in which, for every context, the reward vector has $L_1$-norm at most $s \ll |A|$. Our main result is the design of algorithms that, with high probability, output an $ε$-optimal policy compared to policy class $Π$ using $\tilde{O} ((s/ε^2 + |A|/ε)\log |Π|/δ)$ samples. We extend this bound to general Natarajan classes and complement it with a matching lower bound (up to logarithmic factors), thereby closing a substantial gap left by prior work (Erez et al., 2024, 2025), which incurred an additional $Θ(|A|^9)$ dependence. We obtain these results via two complementary approaches. First, we analyze contextual bandits through the lens of contextual decision making with structured observations, designing an exploration-by-optimization algorithm whose sample complexity is governed by the \emph{decision-estimation coefficient} (DEC; Foster et al., 2021, 2022). We show that, with $s$-sparse rewards, the induced model class admits a sharp DEC bound that scales with $s$ and directly yields the optimal rate. Since this approach is largely information-theoretic and involves solving complex min-max optimization problems, we also develop a second, more specialized algorithmic method based on a low-variance exploration technique. This approach leads to concrete, tractable algorithms and naturally extends to contextual combinatorial semi-bandits, leading to improved sample complexity guarantees for bandit multiclass list classification.

### [249] [Opir: Efficient Multi-Task Safety Classification for Toxicity, Jailbreaks, Hate Speech, and Harmful Content](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29659)
*Ihor Stepanov,Aleksandr Smechov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Real-time safety filtering for large language model (LLM) applications requires classifiers that can detect unsafe prompts, toxic language, jailbreak attempts, and unsafe responses without the cost profile of large guardrail models, and that can distinguish benign sensitive text from genuinely covert harmful content. In this paper, we introduce Opir, a family of encoder-based guardrail models built on the GLiClass architecture. Opir includes multi-task models for binary safe/unsafe classification, multi-label toxicity classification, jailbreak classification, and zero-shot unsafe prompt and response categorization. We also release edge variants with fewer than 100M parameters dedicated to binary safe/unsafe categorization. The models are trained on a three-level taxonomy containing 996 categories across 16 top-level labels, 126 mid-level labels, and 854 leaf labels. Opir's training data combines taxonomy-grounded unsafe prompts, adversarially mined hard negatives, benign safety-preserving examples, generated response examples, multilingual translations, and portions of the Aegis2 and WildGuard training subsets. We also open-sourced an evaluation harness that supports GLiClass and GLiNER2 backends as well as decoder-based models, and covers binary safety classification, multi-label categorization, toxicity, jailbreak detection, prompt safety, response safety, response refusal, and prompt subcategory views across public benchmark families. Across an expanded comparison spanning 12 safety-classification tasks and 17 category tasks against eight contemporary guardrail systems -- including both GLiNER2-based and generative guardrail models -- Opir variants are competitive on or ahead of the strongest open-weight baselines on the majority of benchmark datasets while operating with a substantially smaller deployment footprint.

### [250] [A Geometric View of SRC: Learning Representations for Stable Residual Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29673)
*Vangelis P. Oikonomou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Reconstruction-based inference assigns a class by comparing class-wise reconstruction residuals; Sparse Representation Classification (SRC) is a canonical instance whose reliability depends on the geometry of the learned representation. We adopt a strict training-inference separation: SRC is used only as a fixed test-time rule and is never differentiated, unrolled, or optimized during training. In a span-level idealization based on class-conditional spans and their associated projection residuals, we formalize residual-ordering stability through a residual margin and characterize geometric obstructions -- span overlap, dominance, and near-overlap via small principal angles -- that can collapse this margin in worst-case directions. This span-level theory is primary: it specifies when the idealized residual family is well-separated, and it provides a conditional solver-level interpretation for practical residual approximations (e.g., OMP) insofar as they remain close to the span-level residual ordering. Under explicit coverage and separation assumptions, we derive a quantitative lower bound on the (idealized) residual margin. Guided by these targets, we propose geometry-shaping objectives that promote masked within-class self-expressiveness, discourage cross-class reconstruction pathways and inter-class span alignment, and prevent collapse -- without invoking SRC residuals or predictions during training. Experiments on images (COIL-100), text (TREC), and EEG connectivity evaluate all representations under identical fixed SRC/OMP inference and report residual margins and geometric diagnostics; cross-entropy is included only as a reference geometry under the same evaluation protocol.

### [251] [Kernel Renormalization in Bayesian Deep Neural Networks: the Equivalent Wishart Ansatz in the Proportional Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29684)
*Paolo Baglioni,Christian Keup,Vincenzo Zimbardo,Rosalba Pacelli,Alessandro Vezzani,Raffaella Burioni,Pietro Rotondo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: The scaling limit where both the size of the training set $P$ and the width $N$ of a deep neural network grow at the same rate, the so-called proportional-width regime, has been intensely studied for shallow, single-hidden-layer networks. However, extending these non-perturbative results from shallow architectures to deep non-linear networks has proven very challenging. Here we present an effective approximate approach to predict the generalization performance of Bayesian multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) of fixed depth $L$ on arbitrary high-dimensional data. We propose an equivalent Wishart Ansatz to capture the dominant stochastic fluctuations of the hierarchical empirical kernels of MLPs. This allows us to perform a large deviation analysis for the partition function of MLPs in the proportional limit, expressed in terms of a renormalized NNGP kernel. In this description, even strong representation learning in the proportional limit is encoded in at most $L$ scalar order parameters, determined self-consistently. Extending the approach to convolutional architectures (CNNs), we identify a hierarchical local kernel renormalization mechanism, which allows to quantify more complex data-dependent transformations of the large-width kernel in CNNs due to finite-width effects. We test our effective theory against sampling experiments from the Bayesian posterior of finite deep neural networks with depths $L \sim O(10)$ and $P\sim O(10^3)$ on classic benchmark datasets, finding overall very good agreement together with two distinct types of systematic deviations.

### [252] [A Novel Tensor Product-Based Neural Network for Solving Partial Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29688)
*Qihong Yang,Yangtao Deng,Qiaolin He,Shiquan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This paper presents the Tensor Product Network (TPNet), a novel neural architecture for efficient and accurate function approximation and PDE solving. The core of the proposal involves constructing the solution explicitly as a linear combination of basis functions integrated into the network, with coefficients determined by a direct least-squares solve, thereby bypassing traditional gradient-based training. The key methodological contribution include: (1) an efficient tensor-product scheme that generates multi-dimensional basis functions from combinations of two sets of subnetwork outputs, significantly reducing model complexity and parameter count while maintaining expressivity; (2) a block time-marching strategy to improve computational efficiency in long-time simulations; and (3) a linear reformulation strategy for handling nonlinear PDEs by treating known nonlinear terms as sources. TPNet achieves superior accuracy and shorter training times than conventional neural network solvers. This performance gain stems from its structured design and deterministic least-squares fitting, which contrast with the iterative, often computationally intensive optimization required by mainstream methods like Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs).

### [253] [Momentum Based Reward Design for Low Emission Traffic Signal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29693)
*Chinmay Mundane,Amith Manoharan,Arun Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Urban traffic congestion is a growing global issue contributing significantly to long commute times and environmental pollution. Traditional traffic signal control systems often fail to adapt to dynamic traffic conditions. Adaptive traffic signal control can improve urban traffic without changing road infrastructure. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has shown strong performance for this task, but existing delay and queue-based rewards often produce short-sighted or unstable policies. This paper proposes a Momentum-Based Reward Function (MBRF) that encourages vehicles to keep moving rather than penalizing congestion alone. The method is evaluated in SUMO (Simulation of Urban MObility) using standard traffic metrics such as waiting time, queue length, throughput, and CO2 emissions. Results show that the proposed reward produces better throughput-emission trade-offs and more stable learning behavior than delay or queue-based rewards, as well as classical controllers such as Max Pressure and LQF.

### [254] [A Systematic Evaluation of Molecular Mixture Behavior Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29698)
*Roel J. Leenhouts,Nathan K. Morgan,William Green,Jan G. Rittig,Florence H. Vermeire*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Machine learning for molecular property prediction has focused largely on pure compounds, even though many practical applications depend on mixtures with intermolecular interactions. Recent work has expanded the availability of mixture datasets, but evaluation still focuses mainly on absolute accuracy. However, absolute errors in mixtures conflate pure-component contributions with deviations from ideal mixing. We propose an evaluation framework that decomposes mixture-property error into pure-compound and interaction (non-ideal) components. The framework combines leakage-aware split protocols, ideal-mixture baselines, and excess-property metrics. To support reproducible benchmarking, we curate seven matched pure and mixture physicochemical property datasets. Across multiple mixture-property tasks and model families, we find that strong absolute accuracy can mask poor recovery of non-ideal mixture behavior, and that performance drops substantially under strict molecule splits. These results identify transfer to unseen molecules as a central challenge in molecular mixture machine learning and motivate evaluation beyond absolute accuracy alone.

### [255] [The Little Book of Generative AI Foundations: An Intuitive Mathematical Primer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29713)
*Tianhua Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This book provides a compact, derivation-oriented introduction to the mathematical foundations of modern generative artificial intelligence. Rather than surveying every recent architecture or implementation detail, it develops a coherent route through the ideas connecting major families of generative models, from PCA, probabilistic PCA, variational autoencoders, and diffusion models to normalising flows, autoregressive factorisations, GANs, Wasserstein GANs, and energy-based models. The aim is to make the structure of generative modelling more accessible without removing the mathematical substance needed to understand how these models are derived and related. The book is intended as a foundation-building primer for mathematically curious researchers, practitioners, and students.

### [256] [Bastion: Budget-Aware Speculative Decoding with Tree-structured Block Diffusion Drafting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29727)
*Soowon Oh,Nam Cao,Yujin Kim,Hojung Jung,Huzama Ahmad,Sangmin Bae,Se-Young Yun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Block-diffusion drafters have recently emerged as a powerful alternative for speculative decoding by predicting multiple future-token distributions in a single parallel step. However, since these parallel predictions are sampled from position-wise marginals rather than fully conditioned sequences, committing to a single greedy path often fails to capture the target model's preferred trajectory. To address this, we propose BASTION, a budget-aware speculative decoding framework with tree-based diffusion drafting. Unlike existing methods that rely on static tree topologies, BASTION dynamically constructs query-dependent trees by balancing draft quality against hardware constraints. Our framework integrates three synergistic components: (1) an acceptance surrogate that estimates expected accepted length via path confidence, (2) an online latency estimator that calibrates a hardware-aware roofline model, and (3) an adaptive best-first expansion that grows the tree until marginal gains no longer justify incremental verification costs. BASTION is training-free, preserves the target model's distribution, and requires no per-setting tuning. Across diverse benchmarks and GPU architectures, BASTION achieves up to a 6.61x speedup over standard autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art block-diffusion baselines by 39%.

### [257] [Realistic honeypot evaluations for scheming propensity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29729)
*Victoria Krakovna,David Lindner,Lewis Ho,Sebastian Farquhar,Rohin Shah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We introduce scheming honeypot evaluations, a framework for testing whether models will pursue instrumental goals if given the opportunity. Our scheming honeypot evaluations take the form of coding tasks in Google's alignment research codebases. In a real internal deployment setting, Gemini models do not demonstrate unprompted scheming. If prompts explicitly encourage agency (situational awareness or goal-directedness) and/or give the model a hidden goal, models sometimes scheme or attempt sabotage. Validating the realism of our setting, models show low rates of evaluation awareness, usually due to agency prompts rather than the environments.

### [258] [EMAG: Differentiable 4D Gaussian Mixture Splatting for EEG Spatial Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29731)
*Alex Lazarovich,Ofir Itzhak Shahar,Gur Elkin,Ohad Ben-Shahar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: High-density electroencephalography (HD-EEG) enables fine-grained measurement of cortical activity but requires expensive hardware and lengthy setup times, limiting its clinical and research accessibility. We propose EMAG (EEG Mixture of Anisotropic Gaussians), a differentiable framework that reconstructs HD-EEG signals from a sparse subset of low-density (LD) electrodes by representing brain electrical sources as a mixture of anisotropic 4D space-time Gaussians. EMAG places a mixture of multiple Gaussians at each point of a spherical brain grid, each parameterized by a full 4 x 4 precision matrix, enabling anisotropic spatial spreads and explicit coupling between spatial and temporal dimensions. The forward model renders scalp EEG via differentiable Gaussian field contributions at electrode locations, enabling end-to-end training without explicit source localization supervision. We evaluate EMAG on three public EEG benchmarks (Localize-MI, SEED, and SEED-IV) at super-resolution factors of 2x through 8/16x. EMAG outperforms the current state-of-the-art EEG super-resolution method at most super-resolution factors on three standard benchmarks (Localize-MI, SEED, SEED-IV). The explicit Gaussian parameterization further enables direct visualization and interpretability of learned brain source configurations, potentially opening avenues for clinical and neuroscientific applications, such as source localization or biomarker discovery.

### [259] [MMTM: Tri-Modal Topic Modeling for Long-Form Video via Similarity-Gated Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29765)
*Ali Abusaleh,Bhuvanesh Verma,Alexander Mehler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We introduce MMTM, a modular pipeline for topic discovery in long-form video that integrates speech recognition, audio and visual embeddings, and BERTopic clustering through a deterministic similarity-gated fusion. Evaluated cross-lingually on German (Tagesschau) and English (NBC) broadcast news, joint tri-modal modeling substantially improves topic quality: noise drops from 0.27 to 0.06, transition rate from 0.70 to 0.21, and normalized entropy rises from 0.84 to 0.92, indicating more coherent and temporally stable topics. Cluster validity (Calinski-Harabasz) improves by 5-12X across embedding spaces. Lexical coherence (NPMI) rises from 0.77 to 0.86 on German but is corpus-dependent and does not transfer to the shorter NBC broadcasts. We release the pipeline code and a human-validated 54-hour multimodal video topic corpus with dual-annotator visual evaluation and LLM-assisted labeling.

We release the pipeline code and a human-validated 54-hour multimodal video topic corpus with dual-annotator visual evaluation and LLM-assisted labeling.

</details>


### [260] [Hista and Numca: Estimate State Value Effectively for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29782)
*Zizhe Chen,Jiqian Dong,Yizhou Tian,Garry Yang,Yongqiang Chen,Zhitang Chen,James Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Reinforcement learning (RL) refines large language models (LLMs) by directly optimizing model behavior through reward signals. While accurate state value estimation is critical for stable training in classical RL, it remains an underexplored challenge in LLM post-training. In this work, we introduce the State Value Estimation Benchmark (SVEB) to assess state estimation within existing RL frameworks and show that critics in standard approaches like PPO collapse to a coarse group-average baseline. To address this, we propose two techniques: Numca, which leverages numerical spans as gradable milestones for state value estimation, and Hista, a framework that uses LLM's hidden states as representation to weighted average disjoint rollouts and their return. Extensive experiments demonstrate that both methods yield more accurate state value estimates and enhance training performance across different RL algorithms and model sizes without incurring significant computational overhead.

### [261] [Gated Graph Attention Networks with Learnable Temperature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29803)
*Zhongtian Ma,Hao Wu,Yexin Zhang,Qiaosheng Zhang,Zhen Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Graph attention networks learn neighbor importance through data-dependent coefficients, but standard layers lack explicit control over unreliable feature dimensions and use fixed sharpness of attention coefficient distributions. This paper proposes gated graph attention and learnable temperature for common graph attention mechanisms. Gated graph attention filters feature or message responses to reduce the influence of unreliable dimensions, while learnable temperature dynamically adjusts the sharpness of the attention coefficient distribution. Experiments on homogeneous and heterophilic heterogeneous benchmarks show that the proposed variants consistently improve the corresponding graph attention backbones, and controlled noise studies further verify their behavior under feature perturbations. Theoretical analysis explains these results by showing that gating improves robustness when only part of the feature coordinates are reliable, while temperature is beneficial when global noise weakens the discriminability of node features.

### [262] [The Interplay Between Interpolation and Aggregation in Regression: Optimal Sample Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29819)
*Mikael Møller Høgsgaard,Kasper Green Larsen,Liang-Yu Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This work investigates theoretically the interplay between interpolation and aggregation in regression. We establish that the $γ$-graph dimension characterizes learnability for a broad class of natural aggregation procedures. Furthermore, we prove that an extremely simple aggregation procedure, combining three interpolating hypotheses via the median, is optimal among all these aggregation procedures, and is strictly more powerful than proper learning. Finally, we show that some hypothesis classes are learnable only by aggregating infinitely many hypotheses or by using non-interpolating aggregation rules (which may predict outside the range of their inputs), and any finite interpolating aggregation fails to achieve even trivial performance.

### [263] [When Do Graph Foundation Models Transfer? A Data-Centric Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29828)
*Jiajun Zhu,Ying Chen,Peihao Wang,Yixuan He,Pan Li,Aditya Akella,Zhangyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to reuse a single backbone across diverse graph domains, yet their transfer is often uneven and can exhibit negative transfer. While most prior work improves transfer through architectural or adaptation choices, we ask a data-centric question: which properties of two graph domains determine how much a fixed representation model changes its outputs? Using a graphon-based continuous limit for dense graphs, we show that for both set-based and message-passing tokenizations, any Lipschitz backbone admits an explicit decomposition of cross-domain output shift into (i) graph-specific finite-sample approximation terms and (ii) an intrinsic, relabeling-invariant domain discrepancy capturing structural mismatch. A key ingredient is positional-encoding (PE) stability: we establish stability guarantees for spectral PEs and highlight contrasting behaviors of eigenvector- versus subspace-based PEs. Experiments on synthetic and real graphs validate the theory and translate the decomposition into guidance for data curation in GFM transfer.

### [264] [Open World Autoencoding Drift Detection with Novel Class Recognition in Tabular Non-stationary Data Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29834)
*Joanna Komorniczak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Data stream processing has become a landmark in modern machine learning applications, with concept drifts and novel class appearances posing the primary challenges faced by sophisticated recognition methods. This work proposes an unsupervised concept drift detection method that identifies shifts in known class distributions based on the reconstruction errors of an autoencoder, while also enabling the recognition of novel class samples through density estimation of a proxy representation of samples. Using mirrored autoencoders allows for independent incremental adaptation to changing problem distributions for the two considered tasks, resulting in continuous adjustment to evolving concepts and reliable recognition of unknown samples. Conducted experiments used a diverse set of synthetic tabular data streams, where both concept drifts and the emergence of novelties were observed. The results show that the proposed approach is competitive with current state-of-the-art unsupervised drift detectors and novelty classifiers.
