### [315] [Statistical Embeddings for Similarity, Retrieval, and Interpretable Alignment of Numeric Tabular Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30289)
*M. Ross Kunz,John Merickel,Keith Wilson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Numeric tabular datasets are the dominant data format in scientific practice, yet large language models lack native mechanisms for representing numeric datasets in a meaningful way across heterogeneous feature spaces. Existing approaches either target predictive modeling over individual datasets, which requires a shared set of variable definitions, or lack mechanisms for interpretable cross-dataset alignment. The proposed methodology characterizes numeric tabular datasets through structured exploratory data analysis descriptors, embeds those descriptors into a shared vector space using a pretrained sentence transformer, and quantifies cross-dataset similarity via Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA). Furthermore, a penalized formulation of CCA is applied to recover sparse, interpretable variable-level correspondences between datasets, identifying which statistical descriptors or variable-level quantities drive cross-dataset alignment without requiring shared variable names or feature conventions. Differential privacy is optionally applied to the descriptor set prior to embedding, supporting deployment in sensitive data contexts without requiring access to raw observations at time of comparison. The methodology is evaluated across 15 datasets spanning general-purpose benchmarks, materials informatics, and nuclear-grade graphite characterization. Results demonstrate a total P@1 score of 0.9, with known nearest-neighbor retrieval and cluster structure remaining robust across embedding ablations and differential privacy budgets. The proposed framework provides a principled pathway for integrating heterogeneous numeric data into retrieval-augmented generation pipelines while preserving statistical context, with direct applications to data-driven algorithm selection and simulation model initialization for unknown datasets.

### [316] [Self-Trained Verification for Training- and Test-Time Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30290)
*Chen Henry Wu,Aditi Raghunathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Self-improvement at scale has been a longstanding goal for reasoning models, and there are two natural places to do it: at test time, through verification-refinement (V-R) loops; and at training time, through self-training methods. Both are gated by the same bottleneck: the verifier. V-R loops stall when verifier scores inflate while accuracy stagnates, and when feedback is too generic to act on; self-training fails similarly when bad self-generated data are added to training. Better verification would unlock both, but the capability we want to train, i.e., catching self-generated errors, lacks training signal. To address this challenge, we propose self-trained verification (STV). Our key observation is that, while a model cannot catch these errors alone, it can when shown the reference solution. We turn this asymmetry into a supervision target and train the verifier to imitate a more informed version of itself. At test time, STV substantially improves V-R loops on hard problems, while alternatives (e.g., SFT, RL on verifier scores, and even meta-verifiers) do not. STV roughly doubles accuracy on hard math and lifts it 14x on scientific reasoning tasks (1.5% to 21%). At training time, we additionally train the generator using RL with STV verifier's feedback inside the V-R loop - a procedure we call verifier-in-the-loop training (ViL). Starting from an RL-converged generator, ViL yields a further 33% gain in pass@1. More notably, the generator's standalone pass@1, with no verifier at test time, climbs 30% relative past where standard RL had converged. Hence, the next frontier in reasoning on hard problems may lie in how we train for and with verification.

### [317] [Gram: Assessing sabotage propensities via automated alignment auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30322)
*David Lindner,Victoria Krakovna,Sebastian Farquhar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We introduce Gram, an automated alignment auditing framework to assess the propensity of AI agents to engage in sabotage. We evaluate Gemini models across 17 simulated agentic deployment scenarios that incentivize sabotage. We find Gemini models misbehave in about 2-3% of our simulated trajectories. Many of these cases are explained by "overeagerness" in Gemini models resulting in both excessive role-playing and goal-seeking behavior. In contrast to other alignment auditing approaches, Gram is designed to specifically evaluate misalignment and intentional sabotage in agentic coding and research agents. We additionally introduce an experimental investigator agent pipeline which enables fine-grained targeted experiments to identify the drivers of misbehavior. We find that increasing realism of environments and removing nudges to misbehave tends to reduce sabotage rates close to zero.

### [318] [In-Context Reward Adaptation for Robust Preference Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30323)
*Zhenyu Sun,Zheng Xu,Ermin Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) typically relies on static reward models to align Large Language Models with human preferences. However, human values are inherently diverse and heterogeneous, and a single reward model often lacks the robustness required to generalize to unseen preference domains. While existing multi-reward frameworks attempt to address this, they are often restricted to a fixed set of known domains and fail to adapt to unseen human distributions without costly retraining. In this work, we propose In-Context Reward Adaptation, a transformer-based framework designed to model diverse and unseen human preferences on the fly. By leveraging the in-context learning capabilities of transformers, our approach adaptively infers the underlying reward structure from a small set of preference demonstrations. We demonstrate that while a standard transformer architecture is insufficient for this task by characterizing an asymptotic bias to the ground-truth, incorporating human response time as an auxiliary input signal enables the model to successfully adapt to preferences from previously unseen domains. Our findings show that this approach provides a more robust foundation for preference modeling, allowing for the representation of heterogeneous rewards and preference distribution shift, and offering a scalable path toward more flexible human-AI alignment.

### [319] [Reasoning with Sampling: Cutting at Decision Points](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30327)
*Felix Zhou,Anay Mehrotra,Quanquan C. Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Frontier reasoning models are produced by posttraining base language models with reinforcement learning. Recent work has challenged this by showing that sampling from a sharpened version of the base model's distribution, a so-called power distribution, elicits comparable reasoning without additional training, curated datasets, or verifiers. However, making this method practical requires efficiently sampling from the power distribution. A sampler needs to "mix" to the power distribution, which necessitates moving between modes of the target distribution; intuitively, e.g., trying different reasoning strategies. The samplers proposed in prior works repeatedly select a "cut" position in the current reasoning trace uniformly at random and resample the suffix from that position onward. However, reasoning traces typically contain a few consequential decisions (e.g., the choice of proof strategy or algorithm), and we observe that a uniformly chosen cut tends to rewrite local details rather than revisit decision points. We introduce an algorithm (Entropy-Cut Metropolis-Hastings) that uses the base model's next-token entropy as a proxy to identify key decision points and resample from those positions. We empirically verify that entropy jumps are a useful proxy for decision points and, in a stylized model of reasoning, prove that our method's mixing time scales with the number of decisions in a trace rather than with the number of tokens, which can be much larger. Across MATH500, HumanEval, GPQA Diamond, and AIME26, our method consistently improves over baselines and RL-trained models.

However, reasoning traces typically contain a few consequential decisions (e.g., the choice of proof strategy or algorithm), and we observe that a uniformly chosen cut tends to rewrite local details rather than revisit decision points. We empirically verify that entropy jumps are a useful proxy for decision points and, in a stylized model of reasoning, prove that our method's mixing time scales with the number of decisions in a trace rather than with the number of tokens, which can be much larger. Across MATH500, HumanEval, GPQA Diamond, and AIME26, our method consistently improves over baselines and RL-trained models.

</details>


### [320] [SoundnessBench: Can Your AI Scientist Really Tell Good Research Ideas from Bad Ones?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30329)
*Sy-Tuyen Ho,Minghui Liu,Huy Nghiem,Furong Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Autonomous AI research agents aim to accelerate scientific discovery by automating the research pipeline, from hypothesis generation to peer review. However, existing benchmarks rarely test a fundamental bottleneck: whether Large Language Models can judge the methodological viability of a research idea before expending time and computational resources. We introduce SoundnessBench, a curated benchmark of 1,099 machine-learning research proposals reconstructed from ICLR submissions, labeled with reviewer soundness sub-scores, and audited against source papers. SoundnessBench should be interpreted as a benchmark for recoverable proposal-stage soundness rather than exact prediction of full-paper review outcomes. Across 12 frontier LLMs, we find a pervasive optimism bias: under standard prompting, models frequently rate low-soundness proposals as sound, while aggressive prompting largely shifts errors from false positives to false negatives. Additional controls for public-corpus contamination, paper-identifying phrases, surface features, and human audit quality suggest that this behavior is not explained by a single confounder. Our results indicate that current LLMs are not yet reliable as standalone first-gate evaluators for scientific rigor.

### [321] [When, why, and how do diffusion posterior samplers fail? A finite-sample lens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30330)
*Benjamin A. Burns,Sara Fridovich-Keil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Diffusion models have excellent capacity to model complex distributions of natural data, which has made them a popular and effective choice for posterior sampling in imaging inverse problems. Existing methods can incorporate any measurement model at inference time but must use an inexact approximation for the likelihood at intermediate timesteps for computational tractability. Although these approximations can often work well empirically, their downstream effect on the sampled posterior is poorly understood and can result in unexplained failures. To understand when, why, and how these likelihood approximations propagate to erroneous posterior distributions, we introduce a finite-sample perspective on posterior sampling that approximates the posterior to arbitrary precision as training set size tends towards infinity, for any forward model and prior distribution. Using this finite-sample lens, we observe that popular posterior sampling approximations tend to under- or over-estimate the spread of the posterior at intermediate timesteps, causing downstream consequences including sensitivity to early stopping time, inaccurate relative weighting of posterior modes, and hallucination, both of prior modes that are not in the posterior and likelihood modes that are not supported by the prior. Moreover, we find that the cause of these posterior errors requires neither a nonlinear measurement model nor a multimodal posterior, but can arise solely due to a multimodal prior and inaccurate posterior spread at intermediate sampling times. Our finite-sample posterior sampling approach is agnostic to the type of likelihood approximation and the type of (linear or nonlinear) forward model, and can thus serve as a drop-in diagnostic to evaluate the accuracy and failure modes of existing and future posterior samplers.

### [322] [Fairness-Aware Federated Learning with Trajectory Shapley Value](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30336)
*Daniel Kuznetsov,Ziqi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Federated learning is an emerging distributed paradigm that addresses the challenges posed by heterogeneous, privacy-sensitive data. It enables multiple clients to train a model collaboratively by aggregating their local updates at a server. However, conventional aggregation schemes typically use fixed weights that fail to reflect unequal and time-varying client contributions, leading to biased and unstable learning. To improve fairness and stability, we propose the Trajectory Shapley Value (TSV), a contribution metric that evaluates how each client influences the optimization trajectory of the global model using a validation-based, temporally consistent utility. Building on TSV, we design FedTSV, an adaptive aggregation method that converts per-round evaluations into dynamic client weights, allowing the server to respond to heterogeneous and adversarial participation in real time. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that FedTSV accelerates convergence, improves robustness, and yields more equitable contribution assessments, thereby providing a principled foundation for fairness-aware federated optimization.

### [323] [Efficient Test-Time Finetuning of LLMs via Convex Reconstruction and Gradient Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30337)
*Alaa Khamis,Alaa Maalouf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Test-time finetuning (TTFT) is a rapidly evolving paradigm that adapts a language model to each prompt by retrieving related sequences, updating the model on them, and then evaluating the prompt. However, TTFT is only practical if it is fast: selection and finetuning both happen per query, making each a direct bottleneck. Existing methods trade speed for quality: fast retrieval is often redundant, while stronger diversity-aware selection adds prohibitive per-query cost. We introduce HullFT, a geometric approach to TTFT that addresses both bottlenecks. Given a query, HullFT first represents the query embedding as a sparse convex combination of few training sequences, using efficient projection-free Frank-Wolfe optimization. This yields a support set that is inherently relevant and diverse. We then convert the fractional convex weights into an exact integer multiset for finetuning through a geometric integerization procedure. The resulting multiplicities naturally create repeated examples, which we exploit with Gradient Reuse to amortize forward-backward computation across repeated finetuning steps. Our experiments show that HullFT improves the quality-efficiency tradeoff over current state-of-the-art TTFT methods, achieving lower bits-per-byte at substantially lower total runtime.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

### [324] [The incremental voter model: mean-field analysis and convergence to equilibrium](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28984)
*Fei Cao,Xiaoqian Gong*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了增量投票模型（IVM），一种离散观点多智能体系统。该模型中，智能体持有离散集合{-k,...,k}中的观点，通过随机选择"说服者"进行最多一单位的逐步意见更新。通过推导大规模人口极限下的平均场非线性ODE系统，建立了严格的数学框架来研究观点分布的渐近行为，为理解复杂系统中的社交影响和观点极化提供了理论工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究复杂系统中的社交影响过程，特别是观点极化现象的建模需求。

Method: 通过推导大规模人口极限下基于智能体的模型所对应的非线性常微分方程（ODE）平均场系统，建立严格的数学框架来分析观点分布的渐近行为。

Result: 成功建立了增量投票模型的平均场近似系统（非线性ODE组），可用于研究观点分布的渐近行为。

Conclusion: 本研究为社交影响过程（特别是观点极化现象）提供了严格的数学分析框架，并为未来更高级模型的构建奠定了理论基础。

Abstract: We introduce the incremental voter model (IVM), a discrete-opinion multi-agent system where agents undergo step-wise transitions biased by the opinion of a randomly selected persuader. Our incremental voter model comprises a large population of interacting agents, each holding an opinion represented by an element of the discrete set $\{-k,\ldots,0,\ldots,k\}, k \in \mathbb{N}_{+}$. At each update step as time progresses, a pair of distinct agents are selected independently and uniformly at random from the population, and the first agent (viewed as the ``listener'') updates its opinion based on that of the second (viewed as the ``persuader''), adopting a new opinion that differs from its current one by at most one unit. By deriving the mean-field system of nonlinear ordinary differential equations (ODEs) that governs the large-population limit of the agent-based model, we develop a rigorous mathematical framework to study the asymptotic behavior of the opinion distribution in the mean-field limit. These results contribute to a deeper understanding of social influence processes in complex systems, particularly in modeling opinion polarization, and may guide the formulation of more advanced models in future research.

</details>


### [325] [LLM-ALSO: LLM-Driven Adaptive Learning-Signal Optimization for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29293)
*Xiaoguang Wu,Zhi Zheng,Hui Xiong*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: LLM-ALSO是一个迭代式LLM驱动的自适应学习信号优化框架，通过Critic LLM诊断、Generator LLM提案和分支验证的三阶段机制，为多智能体强化学习提供灵活且可靠的学习信号设计，在稀疏奖励合作MARL任务中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MARL方法在稀疏奖励环境下面临弱监督导致协调和策略改进困难的问题，且通常需要大量领域专业知识或人工设计努力。现有基于LLM的方法也主要面向单智能体、一次性部署，对合作MARL中动态演变的训练过程支持不足。

Method: LLM-ALSO采用迭代式LLM驱动自适应学习信号优化框架，包含三个核心模块：Critic LLM从稀疏回报指标和紧凑行为证据中诊断阶段性学习和协调失败；Generator LLM基于诊断结果生成候选奖励塑造配置；分支验证通过短视野验证和阶段感知适应，仅将验证后的更新投入训练，避免不可靠的LLM修改影响主训练轨迹。

Result: 在稀疏奖励合作MARL任务上的实验表明，LLM-ALSO有效提升了稀疏评估性能和学习的效率。

Conclusion: LLM-ALSO通过迭代诊断、提案和验证的三阶段框架，在稀疏奖励的合作MARL任务中有效提升了稀疏评估性能和学习效率，且仅在主训练前进行分支验证，降低了LLM生成奖励的风险。

Abstract: Effective training-time guidance is central to multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), yet remains difficult in sparse-reward settings where weak supervision limits coordination and policy improvement, and existing methods often require substantial domain expertise or manual design effort. Large language models (LLMs) provide a promising alternative for flexible learning-signal design, yet existing LLM-based methods remain largely single-agent-oriented, one-shot, or weakly validated for the evolving training dynamics of cooperative MARL. To address these limitations, we propose LLM-ALSO, an iterative LLM-driven adaptive learning-signal optimization framework for MARL. Rather than directly deploying LLM-generated rewards, LLM-ALSO decomposes adaptation into iterative diagnosis, proposal, and validation: a Critic LLM diagnoses stage-specific learning and coordination failures from sparse-return metrics and compact behavior evidence, a Generator LLM proposes candidate reward-shaping configurations conditioned on the diagnosis, and branch-validation feedback refines candidates before they affect the main training trajectory. Through short-horizon validation and stage-aware adaptation, LLM-ALSO promotes only validated updates into training, reducing the risk of unreliable LLM-generated modifications. Experiments on sparse-reward cooperative MARL tasks show that LLM-ALSO improves sparse-evaluation performance and learning efficiency.

</details>


### [326] [DynaGraph: Lightweight Multi-Model Interaction Framework via Dynamic Topological Reconfiguration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29511)
*Yanxing Guo,Zihao Zheng,Fangzhou Wu,Ling Liang,Lin Bao,Zongwei Wang,Yimao Cai*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: DynaGraph addresses the trade-off between static and dynamic multi-model reasoning by combining time-division PEFT adapters with hierarchical self-healing mechanisms, achieving near-state-of-the-art performance with 8B parameters while significantly reducing computational costs.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Complex reasoning tasks typically rely on massive monolithic LLMs, which suffer from severe computational redundancy. Existing task decomposition approaches (structured pipelines or multi-agent collaborations) face a critical dilemma: predefined static topologies are vulnerable to cascading errors, whereas unconstrained dynamic agents suffer from trajectory divergence and unpredictable memory bloat.

Method: 1. Execution Level: Multiplexes time-division PEFT adapters over a shared base model, enabling full system training and inference on a single consumer-grade GPU. 2. Routing Level: An Evaluator continuously monitors execution confidence and triggers hierarchical self-healing: Fine-grained Patching for localized data gaps and Subgraph Reconstruction for severe logical ruptures.

Result: DynaGraph's 8B model closely approximates the reasoning capabilities of a 72B monolithic model (87.6% on StrategyQA, 82.7% on MATH). Additionally, it reduces latency by up to 68.1% and token consumption by 68.6% compared to unconstrained dynamic architectures.

Conclusion: DynaGraph's dynamic reconfiguration approach successfully addresses the trade-off between static pipeline rigidity and dynamic agent chaos, offering a practical solution that balances reasoning capability with computational efficiency for resource-constrained deployments.

Abstract: Tackling complex reasoning tasks typically relies on massive monolithic LLMs, which suffer from severe computational redundancy. While task decomposition through structured pipelines or multi-agent collaborations offers an alternative, these approaches inevitably fall into a critical dilemma: predefined static topologies are highly vulnerable to cascading errors, whereas unconstrained dynamic agents suffer from trajectory divergence and unpredictable memory bloat. To address this, we present DynaGraph, a lightweight multi-model framework driven by dynamic topological reconfiguration. At the execution level, DynaGraph multiplexes time-division PEFT adapters over a shared base model, enabling both full system training and inference deployment on a single consumer-grade GPU. At the routing level, the Evaluator continuously monitors execution confidence to trigger hierarchical self-healing: Fine-grained Patching for localized data gaps and Subgraph Reconstruction for severe logical ruptures. Experiments on StrategyQA, MATH, and FinQA demonstrate our 8B model closely approximates the reasoning capabilities of a 72B monolithic model (e.g., 87.6% on StrategyQA, 82.7% on MATH). Furthermore, it reduces latency by up to 68.1% and token consumption by 68.6% compared to unconstrained dynamic architectures.

</details>


### [327] [CONCAT: Consensus- and Confidence-Driven Ad Hoc Teaming for Efficient LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29612)
*Ziyang Ma,Dingyi Zhang,Sichu Liang,Jiajia Chu,Pengfei Xia,Hui Zang,Deyu Zhou*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出训练无关（training-free）的多智能体协作框架 CONCAT，通过基于答案聚类、置信度选leader、基于心智理论(ToM)的启发式预测协作收益，并在剔除部分通信后动态组建临时(ad hoc)多智能体网络，在三个LLM与三个基准上比 LLM-Debate 效率最高提升2.02倍、优于需训练的 AgentDropout，在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上平均延迟降低50.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM多智能体系统虽能处理复杂任务、性能优于单智能体，但智能体间密集通信带来巨大计算开销。已有缓解方案（训练稀疏多智能体图、微调planner）需额外训练，带来计算成本并把MAS限制在特定领域，损害泛化性。因此需要一种无需训练、可即插即用地削减通信开销的协作机制。

Method: CONCAT = CONsensus and Confidence-driven Ad hoc Teaming，训练无关，三步：1) 基于各智能体的初始答案进行聚类（按答案一致性分组），每簇形成一个候选组；2) 依据智能体自身置信度选出各簇的leader；3) 设计基于心智理论(Theory of Mind)的启发式函数，利用leader的答案与置信度预测任意两个leader之间的协作收益；最后按预测收益对通信边排序，剔除一定比例的通信后组织成ad hoc多智能体网络，使低收益交互不再发生。

Result: 在三个LLM与三个基准上的实验表明：CONCAT 的效率（准确率/延迟比）相较 LLM-Debate 最高提升 2.02 倍；优于需训练的 AgentDropout 等training-aware方法；在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上平均延迟降低 50.1%；无需任何任务特定训练。

Conclusion: 以"共识+置信度"驱动并辅以心智理论启发式的收益预测，可在不进行任何额外训练的前提下构建临时多智能体协作图，在保持/提升准确率的同时显著削减通信与延迟，证明training-free的动态协作组网能兼顾效率与泛化性，优于依赖训练的稀疏化与planner微调方案。

Abstract: Although large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems (MAS) show their capability to solve complex tasks and achieve higher performance over single agent systems, they lead to huge computational overheads because of heavy communication between agents. Previous research has made efforts to train a sparse multi-agent graph or fine-tune a planner to orchestrate the workflow better. However, such extra training processes introduce computational costs and limit MAS to specific domains, therefore compromising their generalizability. In this paper, we propose CONCAT, a training-free multi-agent collaboration framework based on CONsensus and Confidence-driven Ad hoc Teaming to efficiently organize agent interactions. Specifically, agents are clustered based on their initial answers, and leaders of each cluster are selected based on the agents' confidence. Then, a heuristic function based on the Theory of Mind is designed to predict the collaboration benefits between every two leaders according to their answers and confidence. Finally, an ad hoc multi-agent network is organized after evicting a percentage of communications based on the predicted benefits. Experiments across three LLMs and three benchmarks show that CONCAT achieves up to 2.02x higher efficiency (accuracy/latency ratio) than LLM-Debate and outperforms training-aware methods such as AgentDropout, while reducing average latency by 50.1% on Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, without any task-specific training.

</details>


### [328] [Evolve as a Team: Collaborative Self-Evolution for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29790)
*Zhezheng Hao,Tianfu Wang,Huanshuo Dong,Ziyan Liu,Hong Wang,Xiankun Lin,Qiang Lin,Can Wang,Hande Dong,Jiawei Chen*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出Meta-Team框架，通过保留执行上下文、协调Agent间通信，实现多尺度自我进化（行为、协作、组织层面），将复杂的多Agent执行经验转化为可复用的改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的多Agent系统（MAS）虽在复杂长视野任务中表现有效，但在执行过程中常出现各种故障，且这些故障在设计阶段难以消除，因此需要系统能够基于自身执行经验进行改进。

Method: Meta-Team通过保留每个Agent的执行上下文、协调任务后通信，使Agent能够交换分布式证据用于进化；并在此基础上进行多尺度自我进化，将执行经验转化为Agent行为、Agent间协作和团队级组织三个层面的可复用改进。

Result: 实验表明Meta-Team在六个长视野Agent基准测试中一致优于单Agent系统、手工设计的MAS和先前的MAS进化方法。

Conclusion: Meta-Team在六个长视野Agent基准测试中持续优于单Agent系统、手工设计的MAS及先前的MAS进化方法，验证了其能够实现更可靠且可扩展的MAS自我进化。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as an effective paradigm for complex and long-horizon tasks. However, in real-world tasks, MAS often exhibit various failures during execution and such failures are difficult to eliminate during design. This motivates experience-driven MAS evolution, where a system improves based on its own execution experience. Yet such evolution is challenging because MAS experience is prolonged and intricate, interleaving multiple agents' execution chains and communication messages, which makes it difficult to identify what should be improved. To address this challenge, we propose Meta-Team, an experience-driven MAS evolution framework based on collaborative self-evolution. Meta-Team preserves the execution context of each agent and coordinates post-task communication, enabling agents to exchange distributed evidence for evolution. Building on this design, Meta-Team conducts multi-scale self-evolution, transforming execution experience into reusable improvements to agent behaviors, inter-agent coordination, and team-level organization. Across six long-horizon agent benchmarks, Meta-Team consistently outperforms single-agent systems, hand-crafted MAS, and prior MAS evolution methods; further analyses demonstrate that Meta-Team enables more reliable and scalable MAS self-evolution.

</details>


### [329] [Evolutionary Dynamics of Cooperation in Next-Generation LLM Agent Systems: A Cross-Provider Empirical Extension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29874)
*Francisco León Zúñiga Bolívar*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本研究将Willis等人开创的LLM行为博弈基准扩展至2025-2026年发布的四个前沿模型，测试其在迭代囚徒困境中的合作/攻击性倾向。结果显示：合作偏见在九种模型-提示组合中持续存在(H1)；跨提供商分歧显著(H3)；自我反思提升攻击性但不支持能力趋同假说(H2)；噪声鲁棒性证据方向性正向但不稳健(H4)。提供商身份是均衡结果的最强相关因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前代研究(Willis et al.)发现ChatGPT-4o和Claude 3.5 Sonnet在竞争性多智能体设置中表现出一致的合作偏见，但尚不清楚2025-2026年的新一代模型是否继承或改变了这种行为模式，以及规模化和服务商多样性如何影响均衡行为。

Method: 采用与前任研究完全相同的实验方案：(1)使用演化博弈论和迭代囚徒困境(IPD)作为基准框架；(2)测试四个2025-2026年前沿模型：Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.4 Mini；(3)覆盖三种提示风格(Default、Prose、Self-Refine)；(4)四种种群构成(平衡/有偏置，含/不含噪声)；(5)每条件500次Moran迭代。

Result: 四项假设检验结果：H1(合作偏见持续存在)获支持——十二种模型-提示组合中有九种在平衡无噪声条件下偏好合作均衡；H3(跨提供商分歧显著)获支持——Gemini 2.5 Flash在有偏置条件下达77%攻击性均衡，GPT-5.4 Mini在Self-Refine下达70%合作均衡；H2(攻击性能力趋同)部分获支持——Self-Refine提升所有模型的ICD，Claude Sonnet 4.6 Refine达最高ICD(0.913)，但Default和Prose提示无系统性趋同；H4(噪声鲁棒性)方向性正向但不稳健——Claude Sonnet 4.6噪声敏感性约6个百分点 vs Claude 3.5 Sonnet的13个百分点，但跨研究差距不具统计显著性。

Conclusion: 提供商身份而非模型代际是均衡结果的最强相关因素；噪声仍是所有模型的通用挑战；研究揭示了LLM在竞争性多智能体场景中的行为差异主要来源于服务商而非模型规模或发布时间。

Abstract: Do next-generation LLM agents inherit the cooperative biases documented in their predecessors, or does scale and provider diversity reshape equilibrium behaviour in competitive multi-agent settings? Willis et al. established a benchmark for this question using evolutionary game theory and the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma (IPD), finding consistent cooperative biases in ChatGPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet. We extend this benchmark to four frontier models released in 2025-2026 - Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.4 Mini - applying the identical protocol across three prompting styles (Default, Prose, Self-Refine) and four population compositions (balanced and biased, with and without noise). Cooperative bias persists across providers (H1): nine of twelve model-prompt combinations favour cooperative equilibria in balanced noiseless conditions. Cross-provider divergence is substantial (H3): Gemini 2.5 Flash reaches up to 77% aggressive equilibria under biased conditions, while GPT-5.4 Mini reaches 70% cooperative equilibria under Self-Refine. Support for aggressive capability parity is partial (H2): Self-Refine raises ICD in all models and Claude Sonnet 4.6 Refine achieves the highest ICD in the dataset (0.913), but Default and Prose prompts show no systematic narrowing. Evidence on noise robustness is directionally positive but not robustly confirmed (H4): with n=500 Moran iterations per condition, average noise sensitivity is approximately 6 percentage points for Claude Sonnet 4.6 versus 13 pp for Claude 3.5 Sonnet, but this cross-study gap is not statistically significant once the predecessor's unreported sampling error is propagated. Provider identity, rather than model generation, is the strongest correlate of equilibrium outcomes; noise remains a universal challenge regardless of model size or vintage.

</details>


### [330] [Discovering Cooperative Pipelines: Autoresearch for Sequential Social Dilemmas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30003)
*Víctor Gallego*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出"两层自动研究（autoresearch）"框架：外层编码代理（Claude Opus 4.6）在真实 git 仓库中自主改写内层 LLM 策略合成流水线（系统提示 p、反馈构造 φ、辅助函数库 H、迭代逻辑 ι），用于多智能体序列社会困境中的合作策略自动合成；在 12 次自主运行中稳定超越手工基线与仅提示词优化（GEPA），并发现流水线随福利目标（效率 U vs 原始罗尔斯 maximin）而异：仅在 maximin 下自主注入显式公平机制（时间轮值/集体阈值），支持"信息设计"解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序列社会困境（SSD，如 Cleanup、Gathering）中 MARL 面临信用分配、非平稳性与巨大联合动作空间等困难，而"算法空间的中心化合成"（冻结 LLM 写 Python 策略、自博弈评估、迭代精化）能在样本效率上远超梯度方法。但这一内层流水线本身有大量自由参数（系统提示、反馈变量、辅助函数、迭代步数等），以往全靠手工调参；作者追问：能否让 AI 代理来设计这条流水线？因此需要一个把"内层合成代码库"当作可搜索设计产物的外层研究代理框架。

Method: 1) 内环（冻结）：策略合成器 M（Gemini 3.1 Pro / Claude Sonnet 4.6 / Gemma 4 26B）按 π_{k+1}=M(p, q(π_k, F_k)) 生成可执行 Python 策略 π: S×[N]→A（全状态可观测、共享代码但按 agent_id 产生异质行为），经 AST 安全检查 + 冒烟测试 + 自博弈多随机种子评估得到奖励与四项社会指标（效率 U、平等 E、可持续 S、和平 P）。2) 外环：研究者代理 R 以 coding agent（Claude Code CLI）在专用 git 分支上读写 pipeline/ 源码、跑评估脚本、查看指标与 diff，配置空间 c=(p, φ, H, ι)，以 J(c)=Φ(Eval(π*_c; G, 持有种子)) 为标量评分，按 J_j > J* + τ 保留/丢弃，丢弃版本在磁盘上回滚（τ=0）；验证流水线（评估 harness）冻结以防奖励黑客。3) 实验：Cleanup（2 LLM×2 目标×2 重复=8）+ Gathering（2 LLM×1 目标×2 重复=4）；福利泛函为 Φ_U=U 与 Φ_min=min_i R_i；基线为手工设计流水线与同等预算的 GEPA（仅优化提示词）；另做 Gemma 4 26B 能力下限、100 次外层迭代的丢弃归因、spec-gaming 检查与算力统计。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 可靠性提升与低方差——Cleanup 上两 LLM 均被提升至 U≈3.1–3.2（基线 1.93/0.86），Gathering 全部 4 次运行收敛至 U∈[2.47,2.52]（基线 0.03–2.42），Cleanup-Φ_U 上运行间差距 <0.05；同等环境查询预算下比 GEPA 高 2–3×（Cleanup）与 20%（Gathering），且 GEPA-Sonnet-Φ_min 会崩溃到"人人清洁、无人采果"的病态解（U=-2.87）。(2) 目标依赖的机制发现——显式公平机制在 4/4 maximin 运行中出现、0/4 效率运行中出现（3/4 为基于 agent_id 与 env._step_count 的时间轮值，1/4 为全体同步清洁/采集阈值机制）；效率目标下研究者改写为静态角色分工（U=3.25、E=0.61、min=-182），maximin 下改写为轮值+分区（U=3.19、E=0.98、min=296），Gemini 上公平仅损失 1% 效率。研究者系统提示 p_R 不含任何轮值公式、目标条件指引或"轮值=公平"的关联，说明该差异是由 J_j 观测反馈自行构建的。(3) 游戏结构决定策略类——Cleanup（成本不对称、公共品供给）需要显式公平机制才能达 E>0.9；Gathering（对称成本、克制型）仅效率优化即达 E>0.94、maximin≈580，无需 maximin 运行。(4) 其他——100 次外层迭代中保留 47、丢弃 46（纯 J 回归 20、迭代回退 11、过度规定 8、反馈过载 4、方差探针 3），外层无生成/验证失败；对全部 12 次运行最终流水线的检查未发现硬编码动作、泄漏模拟器内部或对种子过拟合（|S| 递增 5→8→12 属降噪）。(5) 弱模型——Gemma 4 26B 从完全失败（U=-10 / 0）恢复至 Cleanup 效率 0.87、maximin 1.71（且 maximin 下效率反超效率优化）、Gathering 2.44（接近前沿模型），提示能力低于阈值时公平目标可能是更好的总福利优化目标。

Conclusion: 贡献有三：(i) 通用两层框架，把 LLM 流水线的设计权委托给在真实代码仓库上操作的编码代理，仅需标准 CLI 与 git，无任务特定脚手架；(ii) 首次将 autoresearch 范式（Karpathy 2026）实例化到多智能体决策域；(iii) 以机制/信息设计视角解释发现——研究者充当"信息设计者"（principal），合成器 M 充当有界理性的 agent，流水线配置 c 即机制，信息结构随福利目标 Φ 而变。人类监督的委托边界清晰：人定义"优化什么"（Φ），代理决定"如何优化"，且全部操作在 git 上可审计。局限：外层研究者仅用单一 LLM（Opus 4.6），缺少研究者模型消融；内层 harness（AST 安全检查、沙箱、多种子评估、helpers 骨架、orchestrator API）本身是人工设计的工程产物，限制了可迁移性；内环为 2D 网格世界、全可观测整数状态、H=1000 步短回合，所发现的机制（BFS-Voronoi、agent_id 相位轮值、waste_fraction 阈值）具网格世界形状，向高维/连续/部分可观测多智能体设置的迁移是开放问题；未来工作包括迁移到其他 LLM 流水线、测试对抗性目标以暴露奖励黑客风险、以及支持非对称（异代码）多智能体程序。

Abstract: We study two-level autoresearch for cooperation: an outer-loop AI agent autonomously redesigns the inner-loop pipeline of an LLM policy-synthesis system for multi-agent Sequential Social Dilemmas (SSDs). A researcher agent $\mathcal{R}$ (run as a coding agent) reads the inner-loop source code, edits system prompts, feedback functions, helper libraries, and iteration logic, runs evaluations, and decides what to keep, following the autoresearch paradigm. Across two games (Cleanup and Gathering), two policy-synthesizer LLMs, and two welfare objectives (utilitarian efficiency and Rawlsian maximin), the researcher reliably exceeds hand-designed baselines, sharply tightens run-to-run variance, and outperforms prompt-only optimization. The discovered pipelines are objective-dependent: only under maximin does the researcher inject an explicit fairness mechanism into synthesizer pipelines, a class of mechanism that is absent from its own objective-agnostic system prompt and from every efficiency-optimized pipeline. This supports an information-design reading in which the researcher chooses what to reveal to the boundedly rational synthesizer as a function of the welfare objective. Code at https://github.com/vicgalle/autoresearch-social-dilemmas.

</details>


### [331] [When Cloud Agents Meet Device Agents: Lessons from Hybrid Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30102)
*Corrado Rainone,Davide Belli,Bence Major,Arash Behboodi*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: This work systematically explores the hybrid multi-agent system (MAS) design space for agentic AI inference, demonstrating that while SLMs benefit from LLM assistance, optimal architectures are task-dependent and increased compute does not guarantee better performance.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The design space of agentic AI inference involves a trade-off between frontier LLMs (high performance, high cost, cloud-hosted) and SLMs (cost-efficient, on-device). Hybrid MASs offer a promising middle ground but introduce a complex design space where task accuracy, monetary cost, and edge energy consumption are tightly coupled without general design principles.

Method: The authors adapted two representative MAS architectures to support hybrid inference and studied how individual design choices shift the operating point along the Pareto frontier of power, cost, and performance.

Result: The findings reveal a nuanced picture of hybrid MAS design: SLMs can effectively benefit from LLM assistance, but the optimal architecture is highly task-dependent.

Conclusion: Greater frontier-level compute does not consistently translate to better performance, indicating that resource scaling alone is insufficient for optimal hybrid system design.

Abstract: The design space of agentic AI inference spans two extremes: frontier large language models (LLMs), typically hosted in the cloud and offering strong performance across a wide range of tasks at substantially high cost, and more cost-efficient small language models (SLMs), which are amenable to on-device inference. Hybrid multi-agent systems (MASs) combining on-device and cloud models offer a promising middle ground, but they also introduce a complex and poorly understood design space in which task accuracy, monetary cost, and edge energy consumption are tightly coupled; in the absence of general design principles, hybrid components, although not the most prevalent choice, are typically introduced through ad hoc decisions tailored to specific domains. In this work, we examine this design space more systematically. We adapt two representative MAS architectures to support hybrid inference and study how individual design choices shift the operating point along the Pareto frontier of power, cost, and performance. Our findings paint a nuanced picture of hybrid MAS design: while SLMs can effectively benefit from LLM assistance, the optimal architecture is highly task-dependent, and greater frontier-level compute does not consistently translate to better performance.

</details>


### [332] [Unifying Temporal and Structural Credit Assignment in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Prompt Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30227)
*Wenwu Li,Yuran Song,Mingze Zhao,Bo Jin,Wenhao Li*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文面向「LLM 多智能体系统（MAS）的提示词优化」，提出以「时间信用（temporal credit）」与「结构信用（structural credit）」双向分解终局奖励信号的思路，并据此设计离散的「语言化块坐标下降（Verbalized BCD）」算法：在状态空间瓶颈（逐轮聚合器）与平稳策略（角色提示跨轮共享）两项归纳偏置下，用 LLM 评审判定低信用轮次/低信用角色，只对「弱链」做定向文本改写。实验在 AQuA、MedMCQA、GPQA、MMLU 与 LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Gemma-7B 上对比未优化提示与 DSPy MIPRO，整体准确率普遍提升（最高约 +7~+9），并声称查询复杂度更低、结果可解释；但部分设定出现负增益，附录分析亦显示优化后 MMLU 上准确率无实质改善，且缺乏收敛证明与查询量的实证数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统（MAS）通过多角色、多轮协作（提案/辩论/综合）解决复杂推理任务，但其优化面临三重困难：(1) 计算图离散、不可微，无法反向传播；(2) 监督信号极度稀疏且全局（仅终局一个标量分数覆盖整条轨迹），构成最严重的信用分配问题（CAP）；(3) 现有黑盒/无梯度优化器（RLPrompt、OPRO、EvoPrompt、DSPy MIPRO 等）无法把轨迹级失败归因到具体轮次与具体角色，导致 O(N×R) 耦合提示词空间上的高方差、低效探索。因此作者主张：可处理的 MAS 优化必须引入结构性归纳偏置，把混乱的交互图改造成结构化优化地形，从而把稀疏终局奖励转成稠密、可操作的反馈。

Method: 形式化：角色集 A={a_1..a_N}、R 轮交互，提示词 Φ={φ_{i,t}}，每轮智能体产出 u_{i,t}，聚合器得共享状态 S_t=f_t(U_t;ψ_t)，终局由 J(x,S_R) 给出标量分数 s；因文本离散，改用 LLM 生成的“文本梯度” Δ_{i,t}=G(x,τ,J,i,t) 与文本编辑算子 U 更新提示。两项结构松弛：(a) 状态空间瓶颈——每轮插入一个聚合模块，把交互建模为 MDP，使文本梯度可按轮次/角色分解（Δ_t、Δ_{i,t}），并引入新的优化变量聚合提示 Ψ={ψ_t}；(b) 平稳策略/参数共享——同一角色跨轮共享提示 φ_i（φ_{i,1}=…=φ_{i,R}），使角色能力与随机噪声可区分，并要求跨轮聚合反馈。信用计算：结构信用用单次 LLM 评审对角色自身输出打分 q_{i,t}，加上基于全体话语 U_t 的“同伴视角”代理 p_{i,t}，融合 c^{role}_{i,t}=λq+(1−λ)p，再跨轮平均得 C^{role}_i；时间信用直接取第 t 轮聚合输出的评审分 C^{time}_t=q^{agg}_t。算法（Algorithm 1）为语言化块坐标下降：Phase A 固定 Ψ、选出低信用角色（bottom-K/阈值）并只更新其角色提示；Phase B 固定 Φ^{role}、选出低信用轮次并只更新对应聚合提示，循环直至预算用尽或留出集饱和。实验为纯提示调优（先 DSPy MIPROv2 初始化，再固定预算定向改写），100 条优化集与互斥留出测试集严格分离；评测含四个 RQ：有效性、消融（结构-only/时间-only/组合）、收敛与超参敏感性（阈值 τ、缓冲 m、EMA 信用 α_t）、可解释性（预测迁移与失败模式统计）。

Result: RQ1：在几乎所有数据集×模型×框架组合上优于未优化基线与 DSPy MIPRO，如 MedMCQA/LLaMA3-8B（Debate 61.13，+7.00；DyLAN 61.75，+7.63）、MMLU/Gemma-7B（+5.35）、AQuA/Gemma-7B（+8.97）；多次运行标准差较小。但存在例外：GPQA/LLaMA3-8B 上两者均低于基线（Debate 39.75→35.02/−4.73 与 36.75/−2.30；DyLAN 28.11→29.61 但 MIPRO 更佳），AQuA/LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 辩论设定同样出现负增益，说明增益并非普适。RQ2：结构与时间信用互补——角色敏感数据集（MedMCQA）结构优化贡献更大，聚合整合关键的任务（GPQA）时间优化更有效，组合在 MedMCQA/MMLU 上最好；逐轮分析显示早轮次主导失败（关键证据早期丢失），晚轮次主要影响最终整合。RQ3：本文方法数轮内收敛更快、方差更低，MIPRO 收敛慢且方差大；τ 偏低或 m 偏大偏保守稳定，τ 偏高/m 偏小则更激进、存在性能漂移风险。RQ4：预测迁移表显示本方法“错→对”修复 11% vs MIPRO 7%，“对→错”回退 5% vs 7%，即信用信号更接近结构性诊断而非全局扰动；附录对优化后 DyLAN/MMLU 的 500 题分析显示正确率 55.8%、平均分 3.38，与基线相当——作者自述“并无实质提升”，且 81.6% 题目在第一轮即结束，平均分由 3.59 降到 2.27，失败模式仍以 KNOWLEDGE_DEFICIT(24.6%)、MISINTERPRET_QUESTION(13.0%) 为主，说明信用分配难以弥补知识缺口。

Conclusion: 结论：MAS 提示优化需要结构化归纳偏置；用状态空间瓶颈实现时间信用、用平稳角色策略实现结构信用，并把两者转化为 LLM 生成的“代理梯度”，可实现只针对弱链角色的定向更新，从而在多类推理基准上以更少查询获得更高准确率与更好的可解释性，为自我改进 MAS 提供了一条原则化路径。需注意的局限：(1) 论文多次声称“显著降低查询复杂度”，但正文未给出任何查询量/成本对比数字；(2) 与 BCD 的关系仅为类比与直觉，缺少离散情形下的收敛性或稳定性证明；(3) 附录 D 明确报告优化后 MMLU 准确率无实质提升，与主表的强增益叙述存在张力；(4) 未与已引用的 MAS 信用分配方法（MATTRL、MAPRO 等）直接对比，仅与 DSPy MIPRO 比较；(5) 仅做单数据集内的提示搜索，不主张跨数据集泛化，且改进幅度部分落在多种子标准差范围内；(6) 若干实现细节（如 EMA 信用更新标注为“Section 3”而实际位于实验章、λ/τ/m 的取值与敏感性数据未完整给出）尚不充分，影响复现。

Abstract: While Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) empower Large Language Models to tackle complex reasoning tasks through collaborative interaction, optimizing their dynamics remains a formidable challenge due to the discrete, non-differentiable nature of the computation graph and the sparsity of global supervisory signals. Existing black-box optimizers struggle to attribute trajectory-level failure to specific local components, resulting in inefficient, high-variance exploration. We argue that tractable MAS optimization needs structural inductive biases to disentangle error signals. We propose temporal and structural credit assignment, which decomposes the objective along two axes: (i) temporal credit, using state-space bottlenecks to identify critical rounds, and (ii) structural credit, using stationary role policies to isolate agent contributions. Leveraging these decomposed signals, we introduce a discrete, verbalized block coordinate descent algorithm for iterative refinement. Rather than indiscriminate global updates, it alternates between optimizing role prompts and aggregation protocols, using LLM-generated "proxy gradients" to target only the identified weak links. Across diverse reasoning benchmarks, our approach substantially reduces query complexity while improving performance, providing a principled and interpretable path toward self-improving MAS.

</details>


### [333] [EASE Configuration Facilitates A Reproducible Science of LLM Social Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30258)
*Sneheel Sarangi,Maximilian Puelma Touzel,Aurélien Bück-Kaeffer,Zachary Yang,Jean-François Godbout,Reihaneh Rabbany*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出模块化的EASE架构（Environments、Agents、Simulation engines、Evaluation metrics），并以开源工具SiliSocS（Silicon Society Sandbox）实现"研究问题—场景生成—实验编排"的工作流，通过三个案例研究展示其在社会模拟中的系统化评估、深层追问与既有研究复现/扩展能力，揭示了当前建模方法的局限及设计选择对结果的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被越来越多地用于模拟社会交互，但现有模拟器大多是一次性、整体化（ad hoc and monolithic）的实现，缺乏架构标准化，导致研究难以复现、结果难以比较、下游评估复杂。论文主张要建立"LLM多智能体模拟的严谨科学"，需要先把环境、主体、仿真引擎与评估指标解耦为标准化组件，使研究问题、场景生成、模型配置与评估流程可被明确记录与重放。

Method: 1) 提出EASE（Environments, Agents, Simulation engines, Evaluation metrics）四层模块化架构，将多智能体社会模拟的核心要素标准化；2) 在EASE之上包装"实验研究schema"，以显式研究问题为中心编排工作流：生成场景→配置模拟→执行→评估→追问/扩展；3) 实现开源、research-ready的SiliSocS（Silicon Society Sandbox），提供高度可配置、可复现的EASE配置实例；4) 通过三个案例研究分别验证：对既有研究问题的系统性评估、对复杂问题的深入追问、对已有研究的延展与复现。

Result: 三个案例研究表明：SiliSocS/EASE能够系统性地评估已有研究问题并给出多维度的答案；能够针对复杂问题进行递进式的深入追问与细化；能够复现并延展既有研究。案例同时暴露了现有建模方法的局限，并分离出不同设计选择（如环境设定、智能体行为、评估指标）对关键结果的具体影响，说明结果对建模假设高度敏感。

Conclusion: 模块化与研究结构化的EASE架构配合SiliSocS，可将LLM多智能体社会模拟从临时拼装的单体工具转变为可复现、可比较的科学基础设施；标准化配置有助于隔离设计选择的影响、暴露现有建模方法的短板，并为后续研究提供共享基线。局限在于结论仍依赖案例研究，且LLM社会模拟的外部效度与行为真实性仍需额外验证。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed to simulate social interactions, yet many of the existing simulators remain ad hoc and monolithic. This lack of architectural standardization prevents reproducible research and complicates downstream evaluation. We advance a rigorous science of LLM-based multi-agent simulation by modularizing core components into Environments, Agents, Simulation engines, and Evaluation metrics (EASE). We demonstrate the utility of EASE configuration by wrapping it in an experimental study schema for orchestrating workflows centered around answering explicit research questions in generated scenarios. We contribute SiliSocS, an open-source, research-ready Silicon Society Sandbox implementing a study-structured EASE configuration to enable highly configurable and reproducible LLM-based social simulations. Using SiliSocS and EASE, we present three case studies, showcasing the system's comprehensive assessment of existing questions, ability to dive deeper into complex questions, and elaboration of existing studies, respectively. Together, these case studies highlight the limitations of current modeling approaches and isolate the impacts of design choices on key results.

</details>


### [334] [SpecBench: Evaluating Specification-Level Reasoning for Software Engineering LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30314)
*Grant Hamblin,Kevin Song,Zhanda Zhu,Anand Jayarajan,Sihang Liu,Nandita Vijaykumar,Gennady Pekhimenko*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: SpecBench 是首个面向“规格级推理”的 SWE 智能体评测基准：任务来自 Kubernetes、React、Rust、TVM、vLLM 五个开源项目的真实 RFC 流程，要求智能体在给定初始设计提案、代码库与历史 RFC 讨论的条件下，识别出规格缺陷（遗漏、歧义、不一致、错误）。评分以维护者历史评审提出的缺陷为金标准，采用 LLM 专家小组共识分级（core/extended）、有限预测预算与 SPI 结构化匹配 + 多裁判集成判定。最佳智能体 GPT-5.4/Codex-5.4 准确率仅 44.4%，表明该能力仍远未解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SWE 智能体基准（SWE-Bench、SWE-Bench Pro、TerminalBench、LiveCodeBench）均以实现为中心，隐含“规格已完美”的假设，只衡量在明确需求下的代码生成能力。而真实复杂关键系统的初始规格往往不完整、有缺陷，需经专家评审修订才能进入实现阶段；同时 Claude Code、Codex 等已支持“规格驱动开发/规划模式”，但缺乏对应评测。作者因此提出规格级推理（specification-level reasoning）这一新维度：生成完整、无歧义、一致、正确的系统规格，需理解代码逻辑、系统不变量与项目社区的优先级与设计哲学（如 Rust 对内存安全的严格性、React 对 API 稳定性的重视）。

Method: 基准构建：从 5 个采用正式 RFC 流程的成熟项目中选取已被接受且讨论充分的 RFC；每个任务提供初始 RFC 提案、提案提出前最新 commit 的代码库、以及此前全部 RFC 历史（提案、讨论、最终决议），智能体无互联网访问、无后续 Git 历史。缺陷类别参考 IEEE Std. 1028-1997 的异常分类与既有规格研究，划分为 Omission（遗漏）、Ambiguous（歧义）、Inconsistent（不一致）、Incorrect（错误）。本文仅评测第一项子能力——识别缺陷；修订规格留待后续版本。\n三项关键挑战与对策：(1) 人类专家分歧——引入 LLM 专家评审组，以 5 点 Likert 打分，均值≥3.0 且至少 2/3 专家认可（≥3）标为 core，否则为 extended；评分时 core 权重为 extended 的 2 倍（core 1.0、extended 0.5）。(2) 开放世界验证——借鉴信息检索的评测方法，非金标准预测记为“未判定”而非错误，仅对落在金标准内的预测计分；并设有限预测预算 N=⌈1.25×|G|⌉，超出部分得 0 分。(3) 预测判定——采用两阶段匹配：先按结构化 rubric 将预测与金标准缺陷分解为 Subject–Predicate–Impact (SPI) 三元组，仅当 Subject 与 Predicate 一致才可能匹配（Impact 作为额外信号）；再用 GPT-5.4 与 Sonnet 4.6 两裁判各跑 2 次共 4 次判定，≥3/4 次多数一致方接受匹配，并用中位两两 Jaccard 相似度评估裁判间一致性。评测使用 Codex CLI v0.104.0、Claude Code CLI v2.1.12、Gemini CLI v0.24.0 的默认推理设置（medium / extended thinking / standard）。

Result: 整体平均准确率：Codex-5.4 最高，为 44.4%；两个 Claude 智能体分数接近；所有被测智能体均低于 45%，显示规格级推理仍有大量提升空间。分项结果：所有智能体在 core 项上的准确率均高于 extended 项，符合 core 项代表更高专家共识、权重更高的构造设计。按仓库划分，Codex-5.4 在 React 与 vLLM 上领先第二名系统 9.5% 与 8.6%。裁判间一致性以两两 Jaccard 相似度衡量，作者承认下一版需增加裁判多样性与判定次数。以 Kubernetes RFC 5558（KEP-4671 Gang Scheduling）为例：15 条金标准缺陷（11 core、4 extended），预测预算 19 条，命中 core 7/11、extended 0/4，加权得分 7.0/13.0 = 53.85% 准确率——该例显示智能体能捕捉高共识缺陷，却普遍漏掉外围/次要缺陷，且部分预测（如 API 类型不一致、RBAC 缺失）虽合理但未与金标准匹配，说明开放世界判定下仍存在系统性漏计。

Conclusion: SpecBench 开创了规格级推理这一评测方向，将 SWE 智能体评测从“实现级推理”扩展到“规格级推理”，其基于真实 RFC 的构造、有限预测预算与 SPI 结构化集成判定为开放世界规格质量评估提供了可行方案。实验表明当前最强智能体的规格缺陷识别能力（最佳 44.4%）显著不足，且在 extended（低共识）缺陷上表现尤弱。后续工作包括：扩展到规格修订任务；用领域专家替代/补充 LLM 评审流水线，校验金标准标签、判定匹配并对非金预测抽样裁定以估计被遗漏的有效关注点，报告人-人与人-机一致性（如 Cohen's κ）并建立人类基线；研究预测预算 N、core/extended 权重、裁判数量与多样性、SPI 匹配稳定性等基准鲁棒性；纳入被拒绝、停滞或大幅修订的提案以检验智能体能否识别足以阻断采纳的严重问题；扩展至 Python PEP、Linux 内核、LLVM 等更多 RFC 生态，并评测更多模型、工具与推理配置。

Abstract: Software engineering (SWE) agents are transitioning from code generation to full software development lifecycle automation. A critical phase in this lifecycle is specification design: transforming initial proposals into carefully considered requirements through expert review. Existing benchmarks such as SWE-Bench are implementation-focused by measuring the agent's ability to generate code given fixed, precise design requirements. This formulation assumes specifications are correct and complete. In real-world complex and critical software systems, initial specifications are often incomplete and flawed, requiring extensive expert reviews and revisions before being accepted for implementation. To fill this gap, we introduce SpecBench to evaluate specification-level reasoning: the ability to generate complete, unambiguous, consistent, and correct system specifications. SpecBench tasks are derived from the Request for Comments (RFC) process used by mature open-source projects. For each task, an agent is given an initial design proposal, the project codebase, and all past project RFC discussions. The agent is tasked with identifying specification deficiencies: omissions, ambiguities, inconsistencies, or incorrect assumptions in the initial proposal. We evaluate predictions against critiques raised by expert maintainers during historical RFC reviews. SpecBench contains tasks from 5 diverse repositories: Kubernetes, React, Rust, TVM, and vLLM. We evaluate state-of-the-art SWE agents on SpecBench, analyzing their capacity to reason about system design without execution feedback. The best performing agent, GPT-5.4, achieves 44.4% accuracy.

</details>

### [335] [RTP-LLM: High-Performance Alibaba LLM Inference Engine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29639)
*Boyu Tan,Jiarui Guo,Zongwei Lv,Hanbo Sun,Tong Yang,Kan Liu,Xinfei Shi,Zetao Hu,Yaxin Yu,Chi Zhang,Jianning Zhang,Xi Yang,Wei Zhang,Bo Cai,Silu Zhou,Xiyu Wang,Na He,Yinghao Yu,Wending Bao,Guiyang Huang,Yuxing Yuan,Juncheng Yin,Nan Wang,Lin Yang,Zechao Zhang,Lu Chen,Guoding Li,Tao Lan,Lin Qu*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: RTP-LLM is a high-performance LLM inference engine developed and deployed at Alibaba Group, addressing key bottlenecks in industrial-scale LLM deployment through integrated optimizations including disaggregated prefill-decode architecture, hierarchical KV cache management, speculative decoding, and multimodal support, demonstrating 1.12x-6.3x performance improvements across diverse workloads against state-of-the-art baselines.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) at industrial scale (100M+ users) presents significant performance bottlenecks, including slow model loading, inefficient prefill/decode phase scheduling, poor KV cache utilization, and lack of support for advanced features like speculative decoding and multimodal processing.

Method: Integrated system design combining file-order-driven I/O with parallel I/O-communication overlapping for model loading; Prefill-Decode Disaggregation architecture; hierarchical multi-tiered KV cache management with caching reuse; modular speculative decoding; adaptive KV cache quantization; and decoupled multimodal processing with multi-level parallelism.

Result: RTP-LLM significantly outperforms vLLM and SGLang: 4.7x-6.3x faster model loading, 35-37% TTFT P95 latency reduction with 215% cache reuse improvement, 1.12x-2.48x throughput improvement in speculative decoding, 1.86x-2.52x improvement in multimodal inference, and 35-40% batch latency reduction with 1.9x-3.0x TTFT improvement in quantized inference.

Conclusion: RTP-LLM provides a production-proven, comprehensive solution for industrial LLM deployment, with open-source availability, achieving substantial performance improvements across multiple dimensions compared to existing solutions like vLLM and SGLang.

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized AI applications, but deploying them at scale presents significant challenges. We present RTP-LLM, a high-performance inference engine for industrial-scale LLM deployment, successfully deployed across Alibaba Group serving over 100 million users. RTP-LLM addresses fundamental bottlenecks through integrated design. It optimizes model loading via file-order-driven I/O and parallel I/O-communication overlapping. The Prefill-Decode Disaggregation architecture decouples compute-intensive prefill from memory-bound decode phases, combined with hierarchical multi-tiered KV cache management enabling efficient cache reuse. In addition, RTP-LLM incorporates modular speculative decoding supporting multiple algorithms, adaptive KV cache quantization, and decoupled multimodal processing, with support for multi-level parallelism.
  Comprehensive evaluations across diverse model architectures (8B-235B parameters) have been conducted, where both controlled benchmarks and real production workloads are used. The results demonstrate RTP-LLM's superior performance against vLLM and SGLang: 4.7x-6.3x model loading speedup, 35-37% TTFT P95 latency reduction with 215% cache reuse improvement in production traffic scheduling, 1.12x-2.48x and 1.86x-2.52x throughput improvements in speculative decoding and multimodal inference, respectively, and 35-40% batch latency reduction with 1.9x-3.0x TTFT improvement in quantized inference. RTP-LLM's production-proven architecture and open-source availability make it a comprehensive solution for industrial LLM deployment.

</details>

### [336] [Behavior-Induced Mirror-Prox Temporal-Difference Learning for Faster Off-Policy Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28849)
*Xingguo Chen,Yuchen Shen,Shangdong Yang,Chao Li,Guang Yang,Wenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出STHTD-MP方法，通过用行为策略Bellman矩阵的对称部分替代协方差度量来改进Mirror-Prox时序差分算法的更新几何，并在标准假设下提供形式化收敛分析和平均算子比较，验证了该方法在特定条件下的优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度时序差分方法的实际性能受辅助变量度量几何影响显著。现有Mirror-Prox TD方法使用特征协方差度量，而行为策略转换信息可提供更具信息量的更新几何。

Method: STHTD-MP方法用行为策略Bellman矩阵的对称部分替代协方差度量，保持原对偶变量单一学习率，对混合鞍点算子应用Mirror-Prox预测-校正步骤。

Result: 在标准随机近似假设下证明收敛：行为诱导度量正定、联合均值系统为Hurwitz、有界性由Lyapunov函数论证、随机递归通过ODE方法收敛；还导出投影-预言机遍历间隙界，并基于确定性Mirror-Prox误差矩阵谱半径与GTD2-MP进行精确平均算子比较。

Conclusion: STHTD-MP可获得比GTD2-MP更小的平均收缩因子，前提是行为诱导度量改善了鞍点几何。基准测试验证了该条件，而Baird反例是假设不成立的奇异边界情况。

Abstract: Gradient temporal-difference methods provide stable off-policy prediction with linear function approximation, but their practical performance is strongly affected by the geometry induced by the auxiliary-variable metric. Existing Mirror-Prox TD methods typically use the feature covariance metric, whereas hybrid TD methods suggest that behavior-policy transition information can provide a more informative update geometry. This paper proposes a behavior-induced Mirror-Prox temporal-difference method, called STHTD-MP, which replaces the covariance metric in the primal-dual saddle-point formulation with the symmetric part of the behavior-policy Bellman matrix. The method keeps a single learning rate for the primal and auxiliary variables and applies a Mirror-Prox prediction-correction step to the resulting hybrid saddle-point operator. We provide a formal convergence analysis for fixed-policy linear prediction under standard stochastic approximation assumptions: the behavior-induced metric is positive definite, the joint mean system is Hurwitz, boundedness follows from a Lyapunov argument, and the stochastic recursion converges by the ODE method. We further derive projected-oracle ergodic gap bounds and an exact mean-operator comparison with GTD2-MP based on the spectral radius of the deterministic Mirror-Prox error matrix. The analysis shows that STHTD-MP can have a smaller mean contraction factor than GTD2-MP when the behavior-induced metric improves the saddle-point geometry. Exact numerical mean-operator analysis on two-state, Random Walk, and Boyan Chain benchmarks supports this condition, while Baird's counterexample is identified as a singular boundary case where the strict assumptions fail.

</details>


### [337] [Behavior-Aware Auxiliary Corrections for Off-Policy Temporal-Difference Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28855)
*Xingguo Chen,Zhiang He,Yuchen Shen,Shangdong Yang,Chao Li,Guang Yang,Wenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对off-policy TD学习的不稳定性问题，将TDC/TDRC中的辅助协方差几何替换为行为感知的形式（行为Bellman矩阵），通过两阶段构建（BA-TDC → BA-TDRC）解耦几何机制与正则化的各自贡献，建立了线性预测设置下的收敛理论，并在多个经典基准任务上验证了行为感知几何与正则化的互补价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: off-policy采样下函数逼近的TD学习可能不稳定。现有TDC通过辅助协方差校正实现稳定，TDRC在此基础上进一步正则化，但两者的几何机制未被解耦，缺乏对辅助协方差设计空间的清晰理论理解。

Method: 提出两阶段构建方法：先用行为Bellman矩阵$A_\mu$替换TDC的辅助矩阵$C$得到BA-TDC，再对同一行为感知方程施加正则化得到BA-TDRC，从而分离两种机制的各自贡献。理论分析采用有限状态平均系统形式化，在Hurwitz稳定性条件下证明几乎必然收敛，并通过精确线性误差递推的谱半径比较确定性平均速率。

Result: 理论层面，平均系统在Hurwitz稳定性假设下几乎必然收敛，线性误差递推的谱半径分析验证了行为感知替换的有效性。实验层面，BA-TDC在部分任务上可独立带来显著收益，但面对更难场景时正则化是不可或缺的。

Conclusion: BA-TDC在某些任务上可独立取得优异表现，但正则化对于跨难度场景的稳健性能至关重要。两种机制（行为感知几何 + 正则化）各有其不可替代的作用。

Abstract: Temporal-difference learning with function approximation can be unstable under off-policy sampling. TDC stabilizes off-policy TD through an auxiliary covariance correction, and TDRC further regularizes this correction in a single-timescale recursion. This paper studies a behavior-aware replacement of the auxiliary covariance geometry in the linear prediction setting, which is the standard local model for understanding the feature-space dynamics of value-function approximation. We first replace the TDC auxiliary matrix (C) by the behavior Bellman matrix (A_μ), yielding BA-TDC, and then regularize the same behavior-aware equation to obtain BA-TDRC. This two-step construction separates the contribution of behavior-aware geometry from the contribution of regularization. The linear analysis also provides a tractable model for an auxiliary-geometry design question that arises in neural-network value approximation, where feature covariances and temporal transition matrices jointly shape the last-layer correction dynamics. We give a finite-state mean-system formulation, prove fixed-point preservation and almost-sure convergence under a Hurwitz stability condition on the instantiated mean system, and compare deterministic mean rates through the spectral radius of the exact linear error recursion. Experiments on the two-state counterexample, Baird's counterexample, Random Walk, and Boyan Chain show that the behavior-aware replacement can be highly beneficial by itself on some tasks, but that regularization is necessary for robust performance across harder settings.

</details>


### [338] [The Cognitive Categorical Transformer: Category-Theoretic Inductive Biases for Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28864)
*Al Kari*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CCT, a 306M-parameter architecture combining GPT-2 Small with category theory and cognitive science components, achieves 21.27 PPL on WikiText-103 (12% improvement over baseline). GT-Full simplicial message passing is identified as the primary contributor (84% of improvement). Negative results on consistency-style priors reveal the "structure/consistency distinction": topological priors improve language modeling while consistency-enforcing priors do not.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Enhance language models with cognitively grounded components from category theory and cognitive science to improve perplexity beyond standard fine-tuning.

Method: CCT augments GPT-2 Small (306M parameters) with cognitively grounded components from category theory. Key contributor: GT-Full simplicial message passing. Matched-step protocol (215,000 steps) for fair comparison. Ablations include bypass of GT-Full across all seven-phase activation schedule.

Result: CCT reaches 21.27 PPL vs 24.19 baseline (2.92 PPL reduction). GT-Full ablation shows 23.72 PPL, localizing 84% of improvement to simplicial message passing. Consistency-style priors (sheaf smoothing, adjunction round-trip, curvature regularization) yield negative results.

Conclusion: CCT achieves 21.27 PPL on WikiText-103 (12% relative improvement over baseline), with GT-Full simplicial message passing accounting for 84% of improvement. Negative results on consistency-style priors (sheaf smoothing, adjunction round-trip, curvature regularization) support the "structure/consistency distinction" hypothesis.

Abstract: The Cognitive Categorical Transformer (CCT) is a 306M-parameter architecture that augments a pretrained GPT-2 Small backbone with cognitively grounded components derived from category theory and several inspirations from cognitive science. Under a matched-step protocol (215,000 optimizer steps, matched data, matched optimizer and schedule) on WikiText-103, CCT reaches 21.27 validation perplexity, compared with 24.19 for an identically fine-tuned GPT-2 Small baseline. The architecture therefore contributes a 2.92 PPL (12% relative) reduction beyond what in-domain fine-tuning alone provides. A retrain-from-scratch ablation that holds GT-Full simplicial message passing bypassed across the entire seven-phase activation schedule reaches 23.72 PPL, localizing 84% of the architectural improvement (2.45 of 2.92 PPL) to GT-Full. We present the first ablation-validated evidence that simplicial message passing improves language-model perplexity at the 306M-parameter scale on WikiText-103. Published GPT-2 Large reaches 22.05 zero-shot PPL on WikiText-103 with 6.2x more parameters than GPT-2 Small; this paper treats that number as an external published reference, not as the architectural benchmark. Three negative results on consistency-style categorical priors (sheaf smoothing, adjunction round-trip, curvature regularization) and the joint structural-prior result for GT-Full and PrecisionWeightedPP together support an empirical pattern termed the *structure/consistency distinction*, in which categorical priors that add new topology improve language modeling and those that enforce a consistency identity do not.

</details>


### [339] [Ultra-Reduced-Impact-Encased-Logging (URIEL): propose a new method for selective sustainable logging and post-harvest silvicultural treatment in tropical forest using airborne robotics systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28883)
*Daniel Albiero,Gelton Fernando de Morais,Daniela Han,Flávio Roberto de Freitas Gonçalves,Artur Vitório Andrade Santos,Wesllen Lins de Araújo,Alessandra Maia Freire,Cláudio Kiyoshi Umezu,Mateus Peressin,Francesco Toscano,Admilson Írio Ribeiro,Alfeu J. Sguarezi Filho,Américo Ferraz Dias Neto,Angel Pontin Garcia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"超低影响封装采伐"(URIEL)新方法：以直升机集运(heli-logging)技术为基础，深度集成机器人、人工智能与无人机飞播造林等采后营林措施，并通过数字概念验证、仿真模拟与经济可行性分析（针对不同"直升机—木材"距离组合）评估。结果显示该方法经济可行性高，且能在维持生态系统服务的同时近乎消除采伐对森林的附带损害；但其实际落地取决于高科技产业、政府、认证采伐企业与原住民等利益相关方的协同整合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球热带森林正承受由经济与政治利益驱动的剧烈砍伐压力，而科学证据表明砍伐是气候变化的重要贡献者。传统采伐（地面拖集、砍伐木集运）会造成大量附带损害：林下植被与土壤压实、河流污染、生物多样性下降、碳储量损失，且木材损失率高。亟需一种能够显著降低环境影响、同时保持经济可行性与木材产量的新型采伐技术，以应对热带森林可持续经营与减少毁林（deforestation）排放的现实需求。

Method: 提出URIEL（Ultra-Reduced-Impact-Encased-Logging，超低影响封装采伐）作业体系：核心是以直升机为集运平台（heli-logging）进行"封装"式采运，减少对地面的直接扰动与拖曳；在此基础上引入机器人系统承担伐木、造材与集运等高强度环节，利用人工智能进行木材识别、路径规划与作业优化，并结合无人机执行的采后营林处理（飞播、抚育、监测）实现快速林分恢复。方法流程包括：①依据作业需求确定配套设备概念并完成尺寸与参数设计；②构建数字概念验证（digital proof of concept）模型；③建立有效的数字仿真模型；④针对不同直升机运距（直升机—木材距离）组合开展经济可行性分析，测算不同配置下的单位木材成本与收益；⑤从生态（附带损害最小化、碳与生态系统服务保持）与经济（回报、可行性）双维度综合评估方案。

Result: 研究结果表明：URIEL方法具有较高的经济可行性，在多种直升机—木材距离组合下均能维持可行的成本—收益结构；通过"封装"式直升机集运与机器人、AI的高精度作业，可近乎消除传统采伐造成的附带损害（collateral damage），同时保持生态系统服务功能；数字仿真与概念验证证明该技术体系在工程与操作层面可实现；配套的无人机采后营林措施为林地即时恢复提供了技术保障。

Conclusion: 尽管科学与技术层面的结果令人满意，URIEL方法的实际可行性本质上取决于特定情境下多方利益相关者的整合：高科技产业（设备与AI供应）、政治/政府（政策、许可与监管框架）、经认证的合法采伐企业（实施与合规）以及原住民群体（土地权利、社区共管与社会认同）。因此该方法并非单纯的工程方案，而是"技术—制度—社会"协同的系统性路径；其推广需在推动低碳、可持续热带森林经营与缓解毁林相关气候变化的背景下，以多方治理为落地前提。

Abstract: Tropical forests worldwide are under intense deforestation pressure driven by economic and political interests, and scientific evidence suggests this deforestation contributes to climate change. This paper proposes a novel logging method for tropical forests, Ultra-Reduced-Impact-Encased-Logging (URIEL). This new method is based on heli-logging techniques combined with intensive use of robotics and AI integrated with post-harvest silvicultural treatments performed by drones. The concept of appropriate equipment for this method was developed, dimensions were determined, details were completed in a digital proof of concept, and an effective digital simulation and economic feasibility analysis were carried out for various helicopter-timber-distance combinations. The results demonstrated that a URIEL method has high economic viability and makes it possible to virtually eliminate collateral damage to forests while maintaining ecosystem services. The main conclusion of this paper is that, despite the satisfactory scientific and technological results, the feasibility of a Uriel method depends on the integration of stakeholders intrinsic to the context: high-tech industry; political governments; certified logging companies; and native populations.

</details>


### [340] [Review Arcade: On the Human Alignment and Gameability of LLM Reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28897)
*Hans Ole Hatzel,Sebastian Steindl,Jan Strich*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper empirically evaluates LLM-generated reviews on 2025 ACL ARR papers, finding limited alignment between LLM and human reviews that varies across prompts/models, while demonstrating that authors can effectively "game" LLM reviews through iterative revisions, improving scores for up to 35% of papers.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-generated reviews for scientific papers are being officially piloted by major conferences; assumption that both reviewers use LLM-assistance and authors use LLMs to revise submissions before submitting.

Method: Empirical experiments on papers from the 2025 ACL Rolling Review (ARR); evaluation of LLM reviews from both author and reviewer perspectives; iterative draft-revise workflow simulation to test "gaming" of LLM reviews.

Result: Limited alignment between LLM and human reviews (best-case scenario shows reasonable alignment); significant variation in LLM-human alignment across prompts and models; "gaming" LLM reviews through iterative revision can be effective in specific scenarios, resulting in statistically significant score increases for up to 35% of papers.

Conclusion: LLM reviews show limited alignment with human reviews; LLM-human alignment varies substantially across prompts and models; iterative revision based on LLM reviews can lead to statistically significant score increases for up to 35% of papers.

Abstract: LLM-generated reviews for scientific papers are gaining considerable traction and are even being officially piloted by major conferences. We have to assume that not only reviewers are using LLM-assistance, but also that authors use LLMs to revise their papers before submitting. In this work, we perform empirical experiments on papers from the 2025 ACL Rolling Review (ARR) to evaluate LLM reviews from both the author and the reviewer perspective. First, we identify a limited alignment of LLM reviews with human ones. In the best-case scenario, the alignment is reasonable. However, we also find that LLM-human alignment varies substantially across prompts and models. Finally, we investigate the scenario in which the author uses an iterative draft-revise workflow to improve the submission according to the LLM review. We find that this "gaming" of LLM reviews can be effective in specific scenarios, leading to a statistically significant increase of overall scores for up to 35\% of papers. We publish our code: https://github.com/uhh-hcds/reviewarcade.

</details>


### [341] [Orthogonal Concept Erasure for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28902)
*Yuhao Sun,Lingyun Yu,Haoxiang Xu,Fengyuan Miao,Zhuoer Xu,Hongtao Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 OCE(Orthogonal Concept Erasure)，把扩散模型的概念擦除从"加性参数更新"重构为"乘性正交参数更新"：在 cross-attention 的 W_k 上施加逐层正交变换 W*=QW（由 SVD/Procrustes 闭式求解），从而在旋转神经元方向的同时严格保留神经元模长与神经元间角度几何；并进一步提出"子空间级擦除 + 向量级保持"的非对称目标，兼顾多概念擦除的冲突约束。在 SD v1.4 上 4.3 秒可擦除 100 个概念，擦除精度与非目标保持均优于 CA/ESD/FMN/UCE/MACE/RECE/SPEED 等基线，并可迁移到 DiT 模型 FLUX.1 dev。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文到图扩散模型可能生成受版权保护、冒犯性或隐私相关内容，概念擦除是重要的安全治理手段。现有三类方法各有缺陷：推理期干预易被绕过；训练类方法（CA、ESD、FMN 等）需多轮微调、算力开销大，难以扩展；编辑类方法（UCE、RECE、SPEED）虽用闭式解直接改参数、高效易部署，但擦除精度不足、非目标概念保持不可靠，且流程复杂。作者指出编辑类方法的根本缺陷在于"加性参数更新"形式 W+ΔW：加性更新会同时扰动神经元的方向、模长与神经元间夹角（角几何），三者被纠缠，导致擦除与保持相互干扰。为验证该假设，作者设计玩具实验：对 cross-attention 的 W 做 (A) 仅缩放模长、(B) 神经元级独立正交旋转、(C) 层级共享正交旋转三种受控改造——仅缩放几乎不改变概念语义，层级小幅正交旋转即产生明显语义偏移，而神经元级旋转严重破坏画质。据此提出两条关键论断：概念语义主要由神经元方向承载（C1），整体生成能力依赖神经元间角几何（C2）。

Method: 目标：给定擦除集 C_1、锚点集 C_*（语义相近的替代概念）、保持集 C_0=[C_g,C_n]（通用概念 + 局部邻居概念），求正交矩阵 P 使 W*=PW。
1) 几何重构：将 W*=W+Δ 改为 W*=QW, QᵀQ=I。层内所有神经元被同一正交变换旋转，模长 ‖w_i*‖=‖w_i‖ 与成对夹角 cosφ_ij*=cosφ_ij 完全不变，仅方向被结构化调整。
2) 向量级闭式解：min_{PᵀP=I}‖PWC_1−WC_*‖_F²+‖PWC_0−WC_0‖_F²，堆叠 A=[WC_1,WC_0]、B=[WC_*,WC_0]，等价于 Procrustes 问题 max tr(PM)，M=BAᵀ=W(C_*C_1ᵀ+C_0C_0ᵀ)Wᵀ，对 M 做 SVD 得 P=UVᵀ。其中通用概念项 K_0=C_gC_gᵀ=E_c[ccᵀ] 由 COCO-30k 全部 token 嵌入离线预计算一次即可复用（可与任务无关）。
3) 子空间级擦除目标：把目标/锚点嵌入经 W 映射归一化后做 Gram–Schmidt 得正交基 G=orth(WC_1)、G_*=orth(WC_*)，投影矩阵 R=GGᵀ、R_*=G_*G_*ᵀ；目标为 min −‖PR−R_{*,⊥}‖_F²+‖PWC_0−WC_0‖_F²，即抑制目标子空间落入锚点子空间正交补的分量，等价于 max tr(PM_total)，M_total=−λ_e R(I−R_*)+W(λ_0K_0+λ_r C_nC_nᵀ)Wᵀ，再由 SVD 得 P=UVᵀ。
4) 非对称设计：擦除用子空间级（抑制多概念间的约束冲突），保持用向量级（需细粒度、不受跨概念干扰），作者称消融证实其最优。
5) 实现：编辑 cross-attention 的 W_k（FLUX 等无显式 cross-attention 的 DiT 模型则按 UCE 做法改 MMDiT 的 embedding 层）；超参 λ_e、λ_0、λ_r 分别主导擦除强度、整体生成质量（FID）、邻居概念保持。锚点用启发式策略选同高层类别但有差异的概念。

Result: 对象擦除（CIFAR-10，前五类平均）：Acc_e 4.61%（SOTA MACE 8.32%），Acc_s 98.68%，相对原始模型仅降 0.01%，Ho 97.01% 为最佳；后五类同样在所有类别上取得最高 Ho（如 Bird 类 Acc_e 0.15%、Horse 0.35%）。艺术风格擦除：Van Gogh/Monet/Picasso 上 CS 与 MSCOCO 的 CS/FID 均处最优或并列最优，优于 ESD（擦除强但画质崩塌）与 RECE/SPEED（保持好但擦除不稳）。多概念（名流）擦除：擦除 10/50/100 人时 Acc_e=0.61/2.66/3.44%，Acc_s=96.92/95.91/94.42%，Ho=98.14/96.62/95.48%，COCO CS 26.33、FID 18.33；100 概念仅需 4.3 s（A100 单卡、单步、无需 SPEED 那样的三项预处理），优于 MACE（1800 s）与 SPEED。隐式概念与对抗攻击：I2P ASR 0.11、MMA 0.12、Ring-A-Bell 0.05，加对抗编辑（Ours w/ AT）后 0.05/0.01/0.00，COCO CS 26.10、FID 39.73，在效率与鲁棒性间取得最佳平衡（对比 STEREO/EraseFlow 等训练类方法耗时高、画质受损）。架构迁移：FLUX.1 dev 上对象/风格/名流/NSFW 四类任务均有效，隐式擦除 I2P 0.23、Ring-A-Bell 0.43、COCO CS 25.55、FID 26.29，优于 UCE/ESD/EraseFlow。消融：子空间擦除+向量保持（3.44/94.42/95.48）优于纯向量（7.59/91.37）与纯子空间（4.54/93.01）；K_0 通用概念量越多擦除-保持权衡越好（None 6.72% → Full 3.44%）；启发式锚点优于随机锚点与空锚点；超参消融与设计意图一致（λ_e 主控擦除、λ_0 主控 FID、λ_r 主控邻居保持）。

Conclusion: OCE 以几何视角重构了编辑类概念擦除范式：由加性更新转为乘性正交更新，直接操控承载语义的方向，同时保留模长与角几何；配合闭式解（Procrustes + SVD）与"子空间级擦除/向量级保持"的非对称目标，在单概念、多概念、隐式概念与对抗攻击场景下均优于现有训练类与编辑类方法，且可单步、秒级扩展到 100 概念，并可迁移到 DiT 架构。作者亦承认局限：SVD 在更大模型上带来额外计算开销；子空间级（非严格向量级）约束可能使输出落入中间语义区域，限制其在精细编辑类任务中的适用性；关系性、组合性概念与水印等更隐式概念尚未探索。作者认为该工作为参数空间正交化提供了原则化、可扩展的概念擦除新范式，有助于生成式 AI 的安全与可控部署。

Abstract: Concept erasure has emerged as a promising approach to mitigate undesired or unsafe content in diffusion models, yet existing methods still face significant limitations. While training-based methods are effective, their high computational cost limits scalability. Editing-based methods are more efficient and deployment-friendly, yet they struggle to simultaneously achieve precise concept erasure and preserve overall generative capacity. We identify this core limitation of the editing-based methods as reliance on additive parameter updates. Our empirical analysis reveals that concept semantics primarily depend on neuron direction rather than neuron magnitude, while overall generative capacity relies on the angular geometry of neurons. As additive updates inherently entangle direction, magnitude, and angular geometry, they inevitably introduce unintended interference between concept erasure and overall generation performance. To address this, we propose Orthogonal Concept Erasure (OCE), which reformulates editing-based erasure as multiplicative parameter updates from a geometric perspective. Specifically, OCE applies layer-wise orthogonal transformations derived from a closed-form solution to the parameters, enabling precise concept erasure while preserving the neuron magnitude and angular geometry. Furthermore, to address conflicting constraints in multi-concept erasure, OCE introduces a subspace-level objective with structured subspace manipulation, yielding a more effective and scalable erasure. Extensive experiments on single- and multi-concept erasure demonstrate that OCE outperforms existing methods in concept erasure and non-target preservation, erasing up to 100 concepts in 4.3 s. Code: https://github.com/HansSunY/OCE.

</details>


### [342] [Frontier LLM-based agents can overcome the ontology curation bottleneck for natural phenotypes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28965)
*James P. Balhoff,Hilmar Lapp*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文重跑 Dahdul 等(2018)的表型标注金标准(Gold Standard)基准：让 5 个前沿托管大模型（Anthropic Opus 4.6/4.7、Sonnet 4.6；OpenAI GPT-5.4、GPT-5.4-mini）以"代理策展人"身份，在包含源文献 PDF、原注释指南、UBERON/PATO/BSPO/GO 四大本体及校验脚本的自含工作区中完成 Entity-Quality(EQ)表型标注。结果显示所有智能体的表现均落入原三名训练有素的人类策展人之间的变异范围内，最佳智能体接近但未达到最佳人类策展人（WD），并在四项指标上大幅超越 Semantic CharaParser 基线；本地开源权重模型未能成功完成标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比较形态学中的表型描述绝大多数以自然语言表述，要实现跨研究的比较形态学数据整合，必须将这些自由文本描述映射到本体术语（表型标注）。该工作长期依赖同时精通比较形态学与本体知识的训练有素人类专家，难以规模化，是生物策展（biocuration）流程中的关键瓶颈。Dahdul 等(2018)建立了覆盖 7 项系统发育研究的 EQ 标注金标准，并发现当时的 NLP 工具 Semantic CharaParser 与人类的语义一致性显著低于人类互评一致性。多步"智能体化"LLM（读文档、检索本体、调用验证工具、迭代修正）的出现，使重新评估这一基准成为可能，从而验证 LLM 智能体能否突破本体策展瓶颈。

Method: 复用 Dahdul et al. 2018 发布的金标准数据（203 个 characters、463 个 states，来自 7 项脊椎动物形态学系统发育研究）与合并本体（UBERON+PATO+BSPO+GO，并将策展人添加的 part_of some X 等关系类表达式物化为具名 OWL 类）。语义相似度用 ELK OWL 推理机在合并本体 subsumption 层级上计算四项指标：SimJ（祖先集 Jaccard）、NIC（最具信息共同祖先的归一化信息含量）、Partial Precision（惩罚多余标注）与 Partial Recall（惩罚遗漏标注），每对 EQ 按 SimJ 加权。构建"智能体策展工作区"：以 Agent Skills 格式编写的 phenotype-eq-annotation 技能（规定读原文→拆解 EQ 行→检索三个 OBO 本体文件→必要时以 Manchester 语法后组合 OWL 表达式→输出 10 列 TSV→运行校验器并迭代至无误）；validate_annotations.scala 校验器用于标记不可解析标识符、标识符/标签不匹配（防幻觉）、废弃类、括号不配平等；并提供与原人类策展人相同的《Guide to Character Annotation》。每篇文献每个模型启动一次会话（29 个 characters），在 Claude Code（Anthropic 模型）与 Codex（OpenAI 模型）CLI 中运行。分两轮：R1（Opus 4.6、GPT-5.4）为探索性，R2 改进技能（强制先读文献、扩充检索与后组合指引、集成校验器、禁止派生子智能体）后重跑全部 5 个模型；跨模型比较限于 characters 51–203（因前 50 个用于工作区优化）。分析流水线由 Python 2 移植至 Python 3，MySQL 祖先库改为内存哈希，并移除合并本体中的互斥公理（发现 532 个不可满足类）。另在 MacBook Pro M2 Max/64GB 上用 Ollama 尝试 qwen3-coder:30b 与 qwen3-coder-next。

Result: 1) 五个智能体在几乎所有指标上均落入人类策展人变异范围（95% CI 位于策展人均值 ±1 SD 之内）；Opus 4.6、Opus 4.7、Sonnet 4.6 三者明显超过两名人类策展人（AD、NI）的 SimJ/PP/PR，并在 NIC 上持平或更优。最优秀的策展人 WD 在 SimJ 与 PP 上仍明显领先。2) 所有智能体在全部指标上优于 Semantic CharaParser，SimJ 约为其两倍。3) 会话开销：跨 7 篇文献的输出 token 量从约 44.4 万（GPT-5.4）到 101 万（GPT-5.4-mini）；同族中小模型输出量更大（Sonnet 4.6 为 Opus 4.6 的 1.5 倍，GPT-5.4-mini 为 GPT-5.4 的 2.3 倍）。4) 成本：按 Dahdul 等(2015)人类速率（13.5 chars/h 朴素轮，1.84 chars/h 知识轮，$100/h）估算每 character 人工成本 $7.41–54.35；Opus 4.6/4.7 的 API 等效推理成本仅约 $0.26/$0.43 每 character（实际因包月订阅更低），OpenAI 模型同区间。5) 本地开源权重模型均难以遵循多步技能（编造本体标识符、放弃校验循环、未完成即终止），未产出完整标注结果，故未纳入定量比较。

Conclusion: 在提供与人类策展人等价的工作区（源文献、同一注释指南、四大本体、校验脚本）的条件下，前沿 LLM 智能体执行 EQ 表型标注的语义相似度水平已与人类策展人互评变异不可区分，并远超此前的自动基线；最佳模型尚未达到最优秀人类策展人。这使 Phenoscape 式的比较形态学结构化再标注更为可行且可大规模开展，并支持将智能体系统推广到其他生物策展任务。局限与后续：Gold Standard 自 2018 年公开可能存在训练数据泄漏；本地大模型尚不成功；方法向无脊椎、植物等类群的推广取决于相应解剖本体的完备性，且本研究未评估"为标注新增本体术语"这一能力。未来可改进方向包括以 OAK 等数据库查询 API 作为工具替代文档式本体检索、用命名技能替代冗长 Markdown 后组合清单、加入 OWL 推理器对组合表达式做可满足性校验。

Abstract: Linking free-text phenotype descriptions to ontology terms, typically referred to as phenotype annotation, is essential for the cross-study integration of comparative morphological data. This labor intensive process has heavily relied on highly trained human experts, which makes it challenging to scale and thus a key bottleneck. Dahdul et al. (2018) established a Gold Standard (GS) of Entity-Quality (EQ) annotations across seven phylogenetic studies and used it to evaluate three human curators and the Semantic CharaParser NLP tool with ontology-based semantic similarity metrics; they reported that machine-human consistency was significantly lower than inter-curator (human-human) consistency. Here we revisit that benchmark with five frontier hosted LLMs from Anthropic and OpenAI, each operating as an "agentic curator" within a self-contained workspace that supplies the source publication PDF, the same annotation guide used by the original human curators, the four project ontologies (UBERON, PATO, BSPO, GO), and a validation script. Evaluated against the same Gold Standard, every agent fell within the range of inter-curator variability of the three trained human biocurators of the original study; the best performing agents approached but did not reach the best performing human curator. Agents substantially outperformed Semantic CharaParser on all four metrics.

</details>


### [343] [VFEAgent: A Multimodal Agent Framework for End-to-End Automated Finite Element Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28978)
*Jiachen Zhang,Junyi Lao,Chenghao Liu,Siyuan Liu,Shixin Wu,Linsen Zhang,Boyu Wang,Songfang Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VFEAgent 是一个端到端的多模态多智能体框架，可从工程图纸图片与文字描述自动生成可执行的 Abaqus 有限元仿真脚本并完成求解。该框架由两个模块构成：FEM_VLM_MAS（基于 ReAct 推理的多智能体视觉语言感知流水线，将图纸解析为求解器无关的中间表示 IR）与 Text2Abaqus（验证优先的代码合成引擎，含 AST 静态预检、反思式自调试、经验回放与确定性回退）。论文还提出了一个含 15 个复杂案例、专家校验的分级视觉增强基准。实验显示其在模式有效率（90.0%）、执行成功率与物理量正确性上均优于 GPT-4o/GPT-5/Gemini-3-Pro 等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有限元分析（FEA）是现代工程设计的基础，但其工作流高度复杂、严重依赖专家经验：工程师需人工完成从工程图纸解读、几何建模到物理环境配置的完整链条，劳动强度大、耗时且在参数配置与拓扑处理中易出错，难以适应高频迭代的现代设计需求。虽然已有工作尝试引入 LLM，但存在三大局限：(1) 依赖硬编码流水线与预置知识库，仅将参数填入模板进行"伪建模"（pseudo-modeling），无法满足非标结构的定制化需求；(2) 普遍"视觉盲"——以已预处理的结构化文本或网格作为输入，绕过了最关键的原始蓝图解读环节，损失高保真语义信息；(3) 反馈机制不成熟，调试多停留在浅层语法错误，无法识别隐式物理逻辑偏差，也缺乏融合长期经验与短期反思的闭环自愈能力。同时，现有评测基准（FEABench、FEM-BENCH、EngDesign）多聚焦商业 API 操作或二维理想化几何，缺乏非标工业拓扑覆盖与视觉推理评估，且偏重代码语法而非模态频率、应变能等高保真物理场。

Method: 问题形式化为多模态输入 X=(I, T_ctx)（结构图 + 材料/荷载等文本约束）到物理响应场 R 的映射，并因子化为 X →(φ_perc) Y →(φ_syn) S → Solver R，其中 Y=(G,M,BC,L) 为严格模式约束的求解器无关中间表示 IR（几何拓扑、材料、边界条件、荷载向量）。

Stage-A（FEM_VLM_MAS，ReAct 驱动的语义感知）：由四个角色协作——感知Agent（OCR 与几何基元检测）、推理Agent（推断拓扑连通性与构件类型）、验证Agent（模式一致性审计）、编排Agent（全局规划，维护动态信念状态 B_t 并执行决策循环 a_t=π(B_t, Prompt_ctx)）。关键技术包括：(a) 端到端直接推理，原始图纸直接送入 VLM 而非 Canny 边缘/网格叠加等预处理，以利用模型内部世界知识消解视觉歧义；(b) 约束感知坐标估计，有尺寸标注时推断像素-米制比例建立全局坐标系，缺尺寸时优先保证拓扑一致性（相对节点位置）以保证归一化分析下网格数学有效；(c) 四级分层验证协议——L1 模式完整性（严格 JSON schema）、L2 物理稳定性（静定性/刚体运动检测，如框架结构受约束自由度须覆盖平动与转动）、L3 工程合理性（泊松比为负、钢材弹性模量异常等参数范围审计）、L4 视觉一致性（反向校验图中所有标注尺寸均体现在拓扑中），任一违规即回传推理Agent；(d) 上下文钉定与非退化接受准则，显式上下文管理器将关键约束（如"拓扑优化模式"）固定在系统提示中防止滑动窗口驱逐，并以信息熵损失检测防止非法覆写。

Stage-B（Text2Abaqus，验证驱动的合成）：算法1"反思式合成与神经-符号交接"流程为——LLM_gen 生成脚本 → 循环 K≤3 次：基于 Python AST 的 PreflightCheck（生命周期完整性：job.submit/waitForCompletion 等执行触发与终止信号；API 安全性：禁止删除受保护根容器等不安全内核状态操作）→ 隔离沙箱子进程执行并 Verify 结果 → 失败则由 Debugger 生成结构化纠错反馈并 LLM_Repair；成功则写入经验回放缓冲 H 并返回；重试耗尽则触发 DeterministicFallback（符号交接），回退到将 IR 严格映射为可执行脚本的规则模板引擎，作为失效安全保障。配套机制包括：Run Isolation 目录隔离以避免并行批处理文件冲突；经验回放按误差签名相似度检索 top-k 同构模式（采用启发式结构签名 S=(N_node, N_elem, {T_sec}, N_load, N_bc)，按节点-单元密度比落入 [0.5,2.0] 检索拓扑相关经验）；Schema-Gated Branching 在 IR 含显式优化语义标志时切换到拓扑优化专用协议并注入鲁棒初始化先验（如保守体积约束）以抑制零样本发散。

实现上采用 LangChain 编排，智能体运行于 Python 3.9，Abaqus 内核与 ODB 抽取运行于隔离的 Python 2.7 沙箱；求解器为 Simulia Abaqus 2022，测试硬件为双路 AMD EPYC 9654（384 线程）、512 GB 内存，所有基线与本方法在同一工作站评测。

Result: Stage-A 结构解读：VFEAgent 模式有效率 0.900，显著高于 Gemini-3-Pro（0.417）、GPT-4o（0.583）、Grok-4（0.545）、GPT-5（0.333）、Gemini-3-Flash（0.333）、Qwen-3-Max（0.091）；节点检测准确率 0.815、连通性 F1 0.648、边界条件检测 0.600，综合感知得分 0.704 为最优。基线虽在像素级感知上强（如 Gemini-3-Pro 节点准确率 0.775），但难以将视觉特征映射为严格工程模式。

Stage-B 执行鲁棒性：VFEAgent 在预检安全性、生命周期、物理符合性、边界条件、荷载五项全部取得 1.00，平均 1.00；基线最高仅 0.60（GPT-5，其生命周期为 1.0 但预检安全为 0.0）、0.53（Qwen-3-Max、Grok-4）、0.34（Gemini-3-Pro）。需强调：表2中确定性回退机制的激活率为 0%，100% 执行成功率完全由神经智能体在 K≤3 次反思式调试内取得，而非依赖规则模板。

失败模式分类（基于实验2错误日志）：Type I 生命周期失明占 45%（模型将脚本视为静态描述而遗漏 job.submit()/waitForCompletion()，求解器空转无 ODB）；Type II 上下文 API 幻觉占 30%（混淆对象层级，如调用不存在的 mesh.EdgeArray(...)）；Type III 不安全状态操作占 25%（为"清空环境"执行 del mdb.models['Model-1']，删除受保护根容器导致内核 KeyError 崩溃）。

定性案例（图3）展示了复合上下文调试的自主恢复：脚本崩溃后，Debugger 聚合结构化错误摘要、原始执行日志（含第45行定位）与从经验回放检索到的领域约束（"禁止删除根模型"），Repair Agent 据此生成 try-except 防御块，脚本成功收敛（15 次迭代）。此外自动化流程将建模延迟从人工的分钟级压缩至秒级近实时执行。

Conclusion: 论文证明，通过将 FEA 建模任务分解为 ReAct 驱动的视觉感知阶段与验证优先的合成阶段，大型语言模型在分层验证与反思式调试增强下可达到接近工业级的可靠性：VFEAgent 在专家校验的视觉增强基准上取得高模式有效率、100% 执行成功率与全维度物理量一致性，验证了"从原始工程图纸到可执行仿真脚本与计算结果"全流程自动化（含真正从头几何构建而非模板填充）的可行性，有望将工程师从繁琐手工分析中解放出来并支撑高频迭代设计。

局限与未来工作：(1) 视觉保真度依赖——低分辨率蓝图中尺寸线与构件重叠会导致感知Agent产生连通性幻觉，计划引入矢量图形（SVG）解析绕开栅格级歧义；(2) 3D 重建歧义——单张二维正交视图提取完整三维深度是病态问题，当前约束感知估计依赖标准工程惯例（二维轮廓拉伸），处理复杂非流形三维几何需多视角推理能力；(3) 计划扩展求解器无关的中间表示，以支持 OpenSees、CalculiX 等开源引擎，推动自主仿真技术的普惠化。
